/species/glyptotermes-latithorax/.alate: 有翅成虫头壳棕褐，触角、上唇、前唇基与足灰棕，复眼比头略浅或呈深褐，单眼与触角斑淡色；前胸背板似乎比头浅，腹部又比胸浅，腿节与胫节灰黄，翅浅褐，被毛稀少。头圆形、略长，复眼亚圆形，直径大于它到头的下缘的距离，突出在头两侧；单眼小而呈圆点状鼓起，与复眼明显分开；触角斑小而近半圆，位于单眼内侧的前方。触角十四节，第二节与第三节相等，第四节最短。上唇扁方形，唇基宽扁。左右上颚各有两枚缘齿。后颏长形。前胸背板等于头宽或略狭，前缘内凹而中央没有缺刻，后缘与侧缘连成弧形。翅狭长，翅面疣点明显；前翅中脉骨化程度高，靠近并平行于径分脉，径分脉到中脉的距离与到前缘脉的距离相等，径分脉几乎没有分支。
/species/glyptotermes-latithorax/.en: The soldier has a chestnut-brown cylindrical head with straight parallel sides and an inverted-V ridge between frons and vertex, its arms reaching halfway to the antennal sockets. The left mandible bears four teeth, the third largest; the right two, with an extra cusp behind. Antennae have 13 to 14 segments. The pronotum is remarkably broad and flat, about twice as wide as long. Alates have a rounded head, ocelli well separated from the eyes, and very broad forewings.
/species/glyptotermes-latithorax/.soldier: 兵蚁头部栗棕，前端及后唇基深褐，与上颚背关节相邻的横脊呈黑色；上颚赤黑，眼点比头略浅，后颏两侧边缘深褐；前胸背板浅棕，四周由深色勾出一圈细边；全身毛很少。头长方形，呈圆筒状，两侧缘直而平行，后缘较平直。额部与头顶相交处有一对倒八字形的丘状隆起，中央带凹沟，两个外端各朝向触角窝，只伸到窝的一半；Y 形缝很不明显。左颚四枚缘齿，第一、二枚紧接，其后有一个钝凹，第三枚最大，第四枚宽阔低矮；右颚两枚缘齿，大小几乎相等，齿尖朝后。触角十三至十四节。后颏较细长，最宽处为最狭处的二点五倍。前胸背板十分宽扁，宽约为长的两倍，中轴前半段有凹沟，前缘微凹而中央缺刻极不明显，两侧缘呈半圆形并向下弓，后缘弧出而中央浅凹。

/species/glyptotermes-liangshanensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部近黑褐，上唇黄褐，唇基黄色，触角淡褐，复眼近黑，单眼淡褐，胸背板近黑褐，腹背板赤褐，腿节褐色，胫节与跗节浅黄褐。头略呈方形，前缘为浅凹弧，两侧缘从前端到复眼后缘较为平行，头后缘在两复眼之间接近半圆；侧视额面较陡，头顶的 Y 缝很不明显。复眼近圆形，中等鼓出；单眼也近圆形，与复眼较为靠近。上唇近横条状方形，前缘稍呈弧形凸出。触角不全，第二节稍短，第三节较长，第四节比第三节稍短而比第二节略大。前胸背板肾形，与头连复眼之宽相等或略宽，前缘为浅凹弧，侧缘凸弧，后缘宽弧而中央微凹，面上的中纵线呈凹沟状，前缘与侧缘有稀疏短毛，后缘短毛稍密。前翅鳞甚大，几乎把后翅鳞全部盖住。
/species/glyptotermes-liangshanensis/.en: The soldier has a reddish brown rectangular head, widest near the middle or behind, with faint frontal lobes and a 45-degree frontal slope. The left mandible carries four teeth, the third the largest and set well apart from the preceding one, while the right has two large triangular teeth. Antennae have 10 to 11 segments, the first thick and long. The pronotum is kidney-shaped and flat, with small notches at both margins. Alates have a squarish head and a very large forewing scale.
/species/glyptotermes-liangshanensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部赤棕，近前缘处略深；上唇淡黄褐，上颚近黑而基部略淡；后颏前部淡赤棕、后部黄棕；触角淡黄褐，前胸背板黄棕，中胸与后胸背板淡黄白。头长方形，两侧近平行，最宽处在中部或靠近后头，后侧角宽圆，后缘几近平直；两个额叶只有极轻微的隆起，侧视额坡约四十五度，触角窝后方的眼点极不明显。上颚稍长于头长的一半，后半部粗壮，前端较尖细并略弯，颚基瘤明显。左颚四枚缘齿：第一、二枚呈三角形、大小略等，齿尖稍朝前；第三枚最大并朝向内侧，与前一枚缘齿相距较远；第四枚小。右颚两枚大型三角状缘齿，都朝向内方。触角十至十一节。前胸背板肾形，扁平，前缘浅凹而前侧角向前凸伸，两侧缘呈圆弧，后缘为宽弧，前后缘中央都有小缺刻，面上中纵线明显。

/species/glyptotermes-limulingensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部深褐黄，触角淡黄，复眼黑褐，单眼、触角斑与下颚须黄褐，前胸背板黄褐，翅脉深褐黄，翅膜上散布褐黄色斑点，足淡黄褐。头亚圆形；复眼长圆形，其短径稍大于复眼至头下缘的间距；单眼近似圆三角形，靠近复眼却不与之相连；触角斑近圆形，比单眼大。触角八节，第三节最短，向末端逐渐增大，Y 缝的前臂隐约可见。前胸背板狭于头连复眼之宽，扁方形，前缘中央稍凹入，两侧缘略向后斜，后缘接近平直而中央浅凹，后侧角宽圆，中纵线可见，翅面布满小疣点。
/species/glyptotermes-limulingensis/.book_name: 黎母岭树白蚊 Glyptotermes limulingensis
/species/glyptotermes-limulingensis/.distribution: 海南琼中黎母岭（海拔六百米）。
/species/glyptotermes-limulingensis/.en: The alate has a dark yellowish brown head, long oval eyes whose short diameter slightly exceeds the space to the underside of the head, and round-triangular ocelli close to but not touching the eyes. The antennal sockets bear round spots larger than the ocelli, and the antennae have eight segments with the third shortest. The pronotum is narrower than the head across the eyes, flat and square, shallowly hollowed in front, with the wing membrane covered in fine warts.

/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部深赤褐，上唇暗黄，唇基淡黄，触角深黄，复眼近黑，单眼黄色；前胸背板赤褐，隐约有淡色中缝；中胸与后胸背板棕褐，前半部有黑色中纵线；翅鳞与翅脉颜色同前胸背板，足褐色而胫节、跗节浅褐，腹背板的色泽接近胸背板。头近似椭圆形，两侧略平行，长略大于宽，Y 缝不明显；复眼稍大，中等膨出而近圆形，单眼近圆并紧靠复眼。上唇宽，前缘几近平直，前侧角呈圆弧。触角不全，第二节稍短于第三节，第三、四节几相等。前胸背板略窄于头连复眼之宽，前缘为凹弧而中线前段凹陷，两侧缘弯向腹方，前侧角狭圆，后侧角阔圆并与后缘连成半圆。前翅鳞大形，后翅鳞短小，长约前翅鳞的一半。腹部长圆筒形，腹板中间有线状隆起，形成一条贯穿腹部的中脊线。
/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.biology: 寄主有槐、垂柳、枫香与枫杨。
/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.en: The soldier has a rectangular brownish yellow head about 1.5 times as long as wide, a 45-degree frontal slope, and a left mandible with four teeth, the first with a very short anterior edge. The right mandible has two teeth, the second broad. Antennae have 10 to 11 segments, often unequal on the two sides. The pronotum is kidney-shaped with small notches at both margins. Alates have an oval head, ocelli close to the eyes, and a mid-ventral ridge along the abdomen.
/species/glyptotermes-longnanensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部棕黄，额部坡面向前转为棕色，上颚赤褐而前三分之二近黑，前胸背板棕黄并带一条淡色中线，胸部与腹部淡黄，足淡黄。头长方形，长约为宽的一点五倍，两侧近平行，后侧角呈弧形，后缘平直；Y 缝虽有却不明显，额坡约四十五度，斜面上端中部略微下凹，两个额叶只有极轻微的隆起。上颚粗壮，基部膨出。左颚四枚大形缘齿：第一枚朝前，第二枚较短，第三、四枚宽短而朝内，位置在中点之后。右颚两枚，第一枚接近中点，第二枚宽大、位于基部三分之一处。上唇短，宽大于长。触角十至十一节，以十一节居多，第二节大于第三节而小于第四节，从第四节起呈倒圆锥形。前胸背板稍狭于头，前缘为浅弧而中央微凹，两侧弯向腹方，后缘窄而平直、中点稍凹；中胸与后胸背板有小形翅芽。

/species/glyptotermes-maculifrons/.distribution: 福建（建阳、黄坑，海拔四百五十米）。
/species/glyptotermes-maculifrons/.en: Soldier. Body brownish with a reddish tinge; the frons is purplish brown and the mandibles darker still, while the labrum, antennae and clypeus are yellowish brown. Head cylindrical, the sides widening somewhat caudad and the hind margin broadly rounded. The frons is thickly shagreened, its horns only weakly raised, with about three shallow longitudinal striae; the frontal declivity is steeper than fifty degrees and the eye spot faint. Mandibles short, each with four marginal teeth, the outermost ones reduced to minute swellings. Antennae nine to eleven segmented, the second or third shortest. Postmentum short and broad. Pronotum shallowly emarginate in front. No alate caste is described in the source.
/species/glyptotermes-maculifrons/.soldier: 兵蚁体色以褐为主而带红调，额区偏紫褐，上颚紫褐更深，上唇、触角与前唇基黄褐；后颏与头壳同色而前段深、后段浅，前胸背板黄褐且前缘转深，腹部淡褐，第十腹节背板又呈黄褐。胸、腹背板周缘与触角各节散生短毛，头壳被毛尤少。头壳圆柱状，高略小于宽，两侧向后方稍扩展，后缘宽圆；额面密布细麻点，额角微隆，其上约有三条浅纵纹，额面稍凹，Y形缝模糊，额坡陡于五十度，眼点隐晦。上唇近方形，端缘平直；上颚较短，左右各具缘齿四枚，左侧末枚与右侧第三、四枚仅为微突起。触角九至十一节，第二节或第三节最短。后颏短宽，后缘略弓而中部平直，侧面观其前半与头壳腹缘明显分离。前胸背板前缘浅凹，后缘中央微凹。

/species/glyptotermes-magnioculus/.biology: 寄主记录为悬铃木（Platanus acerifolia）。
/species/glyptotermes-magnioculus/.en: Soldier. Head yellowish brown with a reddish cast, elongate cylindrical, the sides nearly parallel and only slightly constricted at mid-length; the hind margin is broadly rounded. In profile the dorsolateral frontal corners are barely raised, the frontal slope is about forty-five degrees and the dorsal margin of the head is almost straight. Eyes large and prominent, the distance to the antennal socket less than the eye's short diameter. Labrum semicircular; mandibles slender and curved at the tip, the left about half the head length. Antennae eleven to twelve segmented, the third shortest. Postmentum seven to eight times as long as the waist breadth. Pronotum slightly wider than the widest part of the head, its fore margin with a broad shallow V-shaped emargination and a distinct mid-line.
/species/glyptotermes-magnioculus/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳黄褐带红，上颚紫褐，上唇、触角与前胸背板同为黄褐，腹部淡黄，足色更浅，腿节与胫节淡黄而跗节偏黄。头壳作长圆柱形，两侧大致平行，仅中段略收，后缘宽圆；侧面观额顶背角几乎不隆起，额坡约四十五度，头背缘接近平直，额面平展，Y形缝可辨；复眼大而外凸，其与触角窝的距离不及眼之短径。上唇半圆，上颚端部细且弯曲，左上颚约为头壳长度的一半。触角十一至十二节，第三节最短。后颏甚长，约为腰宽的七至八倍，最宽处在前面三分之一，腰区自中部起平行后伸。前胸背板宽度略大于头壳最宽处，前缘有宽广的V形浅凹，两侧近平行，后缘外凸而中央浅切，中纵线清晰。

/species/glyptotermes-mandibulicinus/.en: Soldier. Head brownish yellow, short cylindrical, the sides flaring slightly backwards and the hind margin broadly rounded. In profile the frontal dorsal corners are weakly raised, the declivity about forty-five degrees, and the dorsal margin of the head gently convex. The frons shows a shallow V-shaped depression; the anterior arms of the coronal suture and both ocellus and compound eye are discernible. Labrum trapezoidal with an upturned, strongly curved apex; the mandibular basal tubercle is prominent and the left mandible reaches about half the head length. Antennae ten segmented. Postmentum five times as long as its narrowest breadth, broadest just behind the anterior third. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, with shallow emarginations.
/species/glyptotermes-mandibulicinus/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳褐中带黄，上颚深褐，上唇与触角黄褐，前胸背板、腹部及足淡黄。头壳短圆柱形，两侧稍向后张开，后缘宽圆；侧面观额背角略隆，额坡约四十五度，头背缘微微拱起，后颏底缘平直。额面呈V形浅凹，Y形缝前臂可见，单眼与复眼均能辨出。上唇梯形，端部向上翘起且较弯，颚基峰突出，左上颚长约合头壳之半。触角十节。后颏长度为最狭处的五倍，最宽区位于前面三分之一之后，该区中央有一淡色点状隆起，腰区落在后面三分之一。前胸背板略窄于头壳，前缘浅凹，两侧平行，后缘近直，前、后缘中央的缺切都很浅。

/species/glyptotermes-orthognathus/.biology: 寄主记录为黄葛树（Ficus lacor）。
/species/glyptotermes-orthognathus/.en: No soldier or alate description could be recovered from the source text for this species; only the distribution (Daxian in Sichuan and Chongqing) and the host tree Ficus lacor are recorded. Any morphological summary would therefore be unsupported by the original account, and none is offered here.

/species/glyptotermes-parvus/.en: Soldier. Head yellowish brown, darkening to brownish in front of the frontal horns and fading caudad; mandibles dark brown. Head rectangular and somewhat thick, the sides nearly parallel with a slight median concavity, the posterior corners broadly rounded. The frons is steep, meeting the vertex almost at right angles, and two forward-leaning mound-like elevations stand at their junction, separated by about the clypeal width, with longitudinal wrinkling between them. Mandibles short; the left bears three triangular teeth pointing inwards, the right two. Labrum flattened trapezoidal, barely half the mandibular length. Antennae eleven or twelve segmented. Body hairs extremely sparse. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, deeply V-emarginate in front; hind femora stout.
/species/glyptotermes-parvus/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳黄棕，额峰前方的色泽近褐而向后渐淡，上颚深褐，上唇与触角棕黄，眼点黄，后颏赤棕且前部两侧较深；前胸背板棕色，比头壳后部略深，其余部分米黄。全身被毛极稀。头壳长方形而稍厚，两侧大致平行，中段微凹，前侧角略圆，后侧角宽圆，后缘近平；额面陡，与头顶几乎垂直相交，二者交界处有两个前倾的丘状突起，丘间距约与唇基同宽，其间稍下凹并有纵皱，Y形缝很不显。上颚短，基部外缘略膨，左上颚末端稍内弯，具三枚齿尖向内的三角形缘齿，右上颚二枚，末端均较尖。上唇扁梯形，长度仅达上颚之半。触角十一至十二节，若为十一节则第三节具环并与第二节等长；眼点极小，呈圆点状，直径小于其至触角窝的距离。后颏前部约占全长三分之一，最窄处在后部末端。前胸背板略宽于头，两侧呈弧形下倾，前缘V形深凹且中央有缺刻，后缘窄而中央浅凹，后足粗短。

/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头壳赤褐，前胸背板褐黄，腹部黄色，被毛极稀。头呈宽卵形，复眼大小中等而略突出，单眼小，紧靠复眼；后唇基极短且界限模糊，前唇基较大而呈白色；下唇须各节短。触角十五节，第二节较长，约合第三、四节之和，第三节短于第四节。前胸背板窄于头壳，前缘深凹，后缘向后弓起。翅透明，前段翅脉褐色，翅膜上密布明显的小瘤突；径分脉与中脉互相平行且不分枝，二者之间具多条微弱联系脉；肘脉很不明显，约有十五个分支。
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.biology: 寄主记录为橡胶树与破布木。
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.distribution: 台湾、海南（那大）、云南（屏边、南溪、金平勐喇，海拔四百七十米）、广西、湖南、西藏（墨脱背崩，海拔九百一十米）；亦见于日本。
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.en: Soldier. The front of the head is deep orange-red mixed with brown, fading backwards to yellow; the body hairs are short and sparse. Head like a long cylinder of very variable length, the frons inclined at about forty-five degrees, with two side-by-side mountain-like elevations where the declivity meets the vertex; the horizontal length of this slope is roughly one seventh of the head. Left mandible with three distinct marginal teeth plus a broad, low fourth that is sometimes absent; right mandible with two conspicuous triangular teeth. Antennae twelve to fifteen segmented. Alate: head russet, antennae fifteen segmented, forewing membrane strongly tuberculate, radius and media parallel and unbranched, cubitus with about fifteen branches.
/species/glyptotermes-satsumensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部前段为深橘红而杂有褐色，向后逐渐变浅，末端转为黄色；触角、胸部、腹部与足均黄。全身毛短且稀。头壳略似长筒，长度个体间差异颇大；侧面额面倾斜约四十五度，斜面顶端与头顶相接处形成两个并列的山状隆起，该斜面的水平长度约为头壳的七分之一。头两侧接近平行，后缘略向后弓。后唇基与头壳分界不清，前唇基为短梯形；上唇前缘圆弧，约伸至上颚中点。上颚粗壮，左上颚内缘有三枚明显缘齿，另有第四枚宽低而不显，前三枚彼此靠拢，第四枚与之相距较远，部分个体第四枚完全消失；右上颚内缘有二枚显著的三角形缘齿。触角十二至十五节，第二至四节长度不定。眼点位于触角后方。前胸背板与头壳同宽或稍窄，前缘略向后凹，其后方有一浅横槽，侧缘与后缘连成弓形，前、后缘中央稍有缺刻；中胸与后胸具短翅芽，体小者则无。腿节粗短，腹部较长并具刺突。

/species/glyptotermes-shaanxiensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头棕褐，上唇土黄，唇基淡黄，复眼近黑，单眼黄，触角与足黄褐，前胸背板与头同色，中、后胸及腹部棕色，腹端数节腹板较深。头近圆形，两侧几乎平行，长略大于宽；复眼大而突出，近圆形，单眼小而略隆起，位于复眼上方并与之留有间距。上唇宽短，前缘平直，前侧角圆弧状。触角以第三节最短，第四节等于或略长于第三节。前胸背板略宽于头壳（含复眼），前缘凹陷，两侧缘弧形，后侧角宽圆，后缘稍平；前翅鳞大，可覆盖后胸，后翅鳞仅及其半。
/species/glyptotermes-shaanxiensis/.en: Soldier. Head brownish yellow, nearly rectangular and cylindrical, the sides subparallel, the front slightly broader, the hind margin straight; the frontal declivity about forty-five degrees with a low swelling and a shallow median hollow. Mandibles stout; the left with four marginal teeth, the third largest and directed inwards, the first and second subequal and forward-pointing, the fourth small; the right with three. Antennae usually ten or eleven segmented, the third shortest. Postmentum slender and flat, broad in front and narrow behind. Alate: head roundish, eyes large and prominent, the third antennal segment shortest, forewing scale covering the metanotum while the hind scale is about half as long.
/species/glyptotermes-shaanxiensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部棕黄，额部陡坡处转棕，唇基黄，上唇黄色半透明，上颚赤褐而端部三分之二近黑，后颏前段棕黄而后段色浅，前胸背板棕黄且常具淡色中纵线，中、后胸及腹部淡黄，腿节、胫节淡黄，胫节端刺黄褐，跗节深黄。全身具稀疏短毛。头壳近长方形，圆筒状，两侧大致平行，前端往往略宽，后侧角弧形，后缘平直；额面坡度约四十五度，额峰微隆，中部略凹，Y形缝不显，唇基梯形，上唇短宽，两侧弧形，前缘近平。上颚粗壮，先端稍弯，基部宽扁；左上颚内缘四枚缘齿，第三枚最大而齿尖向内，第一枚与第二枚大小相仿、齿尖向前，第四枚短小；右上颚三枚缘齿，第一枚位于近端三分之一处，第二枚大而基部宽，第三枚矮小、居于基部。触角多为十至十一节，个别十二节，以第三节最短，第二节略长于第三节而短于其他各节。眼点圆，位于触角窝后方。后颏细长平坦，前宽后窄，柄部狭长而两侧平行，基部向外扩张。前胸背板通常略窄于头壳，前缘浅弧并中央内陷，前侧角前突，两侧缘弧形，后缘近平而中央稍凹，中、后胸背板两侧角向后延伸。

/species/glyptotermes-simaoensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部棕褐，胸、腹背板赤褐，上唇、触角与足黄。头壳被毛少，前胸背板有稀疏刚毛与短毛，腹部背板亦仅有稀疏长短毛。头近圆形，Y形缝隐约可见，触角斑极不明显；复眼椭圆形且突出，其短径稍大于至头壳下缘的距离；单眼小，卵形，略隆起，与复眼分离但相距很近。触角十二节，第二至四节几乎等长。前胸背板前缘宽浅凹，后缘稍平，前后缘中部均无凹刻。翅狭长，翅面散布许多略隆起的褐色小斑点；前翅中脉骨化强，自翅基缝独立伸出，靠拢并平行于径分脉，二者均不分枝，肘脉非骨化，除基部四个分支较明显外余皆模糊；后翅中脉亦强骨化，在翅基约八分之一处与径分脉合并，其后平行于径分脉而无分支，肘脉非骨化，基部四至五分支较清楚，其余不显。
/species/glyptotermes-simaoensis/.en: Soldier. Head yellowish brown, paler and orange-tinged behind, the forehead darker brown; mandibles blackish brown with reddish bases. Head rectangular, the middle and posterior sides nearly parallel, narrowing slightly from the antennal sockets to the mandibular bases; a broad Y-shaped elevation with a shallow median groove marks the junction of frons and vertex. The first left marginal tooth is close to and larger than the second; the right mandible carries two. Antennae eleven segmented, the third or fourth short. Alate: head roundish, eyes oval and prominent, antennae twelve segmented, wings narrow with densely scattered brown tubercles, the media strongly sclerotized and parallel to the radial sector.
/species/glyptotermes-simaoensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部黄褐，头后较淡而略呈橙黄，前额较深呈棕褐，上颚黑褐而基部褐红，上唇、触角与前胸背板黄。头壳被毛少，上唇前缘有八至十根毛，前胸背板周缘有稀疏刚毛。头壳长方形，中后段两侧近乎平行，前部自触角窝至颚基稍有收缩，后缘稍平；前额与头顶交界处呈宽Y形隆起，中间有浅凹沟，横脊略隆，Y形缝隐约可辨。左上颚第一缘齿靠近且大于第二缘齿，右上颚内缘二枚缘齿，第一枚大于第二枚。触角十一节，第三节或第四节较短。后颏前端三分之一处最宽，可达最狭处两倍以上。前胸背板宽几与头壳相等，前缘有宽而浅的凹缘，后缘稍平，前、后缘中部均无缺刻。

/species/glyptotermes-succineus/.en: Soldier. Head amber brown, elongate cylindrical with parallel sides and broadly rounded hind corners; the last abdominal tergite is more heavily sclerotized and darker. In profile the frontal dorsal corners are slightly raised and the declivity about forty-five degrees, the frons shallowly V-depressed with several faint longitudinal striae; the eyes are visible and lie closer to the antennal sockets than their own transverse diameter. Labrum short and rounded with a truncate margin. Mandibles short and stout, strongly curved apically, the left less than half the head length. Antennae twelve segmented. Postmentum six to seven times as long as the waist, its broad trapezoidal part in the anterior third. Pronotum narrower than the head.
/species/glyptotermes-succineus/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳呈琥珀般的褐色，上颚黑褐，上唇、触角与眼点褐，前胸背板黄褐，腹部淡黄褐，第十腹背板后半部几丁质化较强而色深，足与头壳同为褐色或稍浅。头壳长圆柱形，两侧平行，后侧角宽圆；侧面观额背角稍隆，额坡约四十五度，额面呈V形浅凹，中央有数条浅纵纹，Y形缝隐约，复眼可见，其与触角窝的距离小于眼的横径。上唇略作短圆形，唇端平；上颚短壮而末端较弯，左上颚短于头壳之半。触角十二节。后颏长为腰狭处的六至七倍，宽区在前方三分之一，呈梯形，颏前部两侧微向内凹，前缘后方低陷并具数条横纹；腰区位于后部三分之一，后缘弧凸。前胸背板窄于头，前缘浅凹而中央微缺切，两侧缘缓缓斜向后，后缘中央稍向前凹，中线色淡而下凹。

/species/glyptotermes-tsaii/.alate: 有翅成虫头棕褐，上唇褐色，前唇基与触角淡褐，复眼赤褐，单眼色淡，触角斑浅棕；前胸背板与腹板均比头壳浅，腿节、胫节淡褐，翅棕褐而略浅于头壳，被毛稀少。头近圆形而稍长，复眼不太圆，呈半圆状外凸，其长径约为至头壳下缘距离的一点五倍；单眼在复眼内侧，中央隆起；两触角窝内侧各有一枚长圆形触角斑，比单眼小，中央微隆。Y形缝自头背中央斜向单眼，中轴缝极不清楚；头后缘中央有时有纵缝伸达头背三分之一处。触角十五至十六节，第二、三节等长。上唇扁方形，背面微隆，唇基近扁梯形。前胸背板宽于头壳（不计复眼），宽约为其中长的两倍，前缘圆弧状凹入而中央缺刻浅，侧缘呈弧状向后弯入，后缘中部微凹。翅狭长，伸出腹端，其长度约与腹部相当，翅面密布小瘤点；径脉仅达翅长四分之一，径分脉与中脉平行，直至翅前侧角，径分脉不分枝。
/species/glyptotermes-tsaii/.distribution: 云南（贡山，海拔一千五百米）。
/species/glyptotermes-tsaii/.en: Alate. Head brownish, nearly circular but slightly elongate, the compound eyes protruding as half-circles whose long diameter is about one and a half times the distance to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli lie inside the eyes and are centrally raised, and a small oval antennal spot sits inside each antennal socket. Antennae fifteen to sixteen segmented, the second and third equal. Pronotum wider than the head, about twice as broad as long, with a shallow arc-shaped emargination in front. Wings narrow, longer than the abdomen, densely covered with small tubercles; the radius reaches only a quarter of the wing length, the radial sector being unbranched and parallel to the media.

/species/glyptotermes-xiamenensis/.en: Soldier. Head, labrum and pronotum reddish yellow, the forehead and mandibles red-brown; antennae, legs and abdomen yellow. Hairs on the head are few, while the labrum and pronotum carry stouter setae and the abdominal tergites sparse long ones. Head rectangular, rather stout and short, the sides slightly parallel, the forehead raised on both sides with a shallow median hollow. Mandibles short and thick, three marginal teeth on the left and two on the right. Labrum oval-oblong with a bluntly rounded fore margin, about as long as wide. Antennae ten segmented, the third short and small. Postmentum widest a little in front of the middle, less than twice as wide as its narrowest part. Pronotum butterfly-shaped, with a wide anterior emargination.
/species/glyptotermes-xiamenensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部、上唇与前胸背板赤黄，前额与上颚红褐，触角、足及腹部黄。头部毛少，上唇和前胸背板刚毛较多，腹部背板有稀疏长刚毛。头壳长方形，较粗短，两侧略平行，前额左右稍隆起而中间微低凹。上颚粗短，左上颚三枚缘齿，右上颚二枚。上唇长圆形，前缘圆钝，长宽几乎相等。触角十节，第三节短小。后颏以中部偏前处最宽，前缘及腰部收缩处最窄，最宽处不及最窄处的两倍。前胸背板形似展翅的蝶，前缘为宽凹缘，后缘微凹。

/species/glyptotermes-yingdeensis/.en: The source account for this species supplies only the locality, Yingde in Guangdong, and no description of either the soldier or the alate caste survives. No morphological statement is therefore made here.

/species/glyptotermes-yui/.alate: 脱翅成虫头深褐黄，复眼黑褐，单眼、触角、上唇与后颏淡黄褐，前胸背板比头壳稍淡，足与腹部淡黄褐。头近圆形，复眼长圆形，其短径约为眼至头壳下缘距离的两倍多；单眼椭圆形，靠近复眼；触角斑与头盖缝均不清楚；触角十节，第二至四节近等长。前胸背板稍窄于头壳或与头壳（含复眼）等宽。
/species/glyptotermes-yui/.en: Soldier. Head yellowish brown tinged with red, elongate cylindrical with parallel sides and a straight hind margin. In profile the frontal dorsal corners and the anterior frontal corners are both elevated, the frontal declivity reaching about sixty degrees, the frons shallowly V-depressed between the horns; the coronal suture and ocelli are invisible while the compound eyes remain discernible. Labrum nearly circular; mandibles short and stout with a strongly curved apex and a distinct basal tubercle, the left shorter than half the head. Antennae thirteen segmented. Postmentum seven to eight times as long as the waist. Dealate: head roundish, antennae ten segmented, eyes oval.
/species/glyptotermes-yui/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳黄褐带红，上颚紫褐，上唇、触角与前胸背板淡褐，腹部与足淡黄褐。头壳长圆柱形，两侧平行，后缘平直；侧面观额背角隆起，额坡约六十度，额前侧角亦突，头背缘与后颏底缘均近直，额面在两额背角之间呈V形浅凹；Y形缝与单眼都看不到，复眼可辨。上唇近圆形，上颚短壮而末端颇弯，颚基峰明显，左上颚短于头壳的一半。触角十三节。后颏长为腰狭处的七至八倍，最宽区在前部三分之一之前，前缘之后有数条横纹，两侧缘叶缺清楚，腰区位于后部三分之一。前胸背板窄于头壳，前缘有宽的V形浅凹，两侧缘斜向后，后缘中央凹入很浅。

/species/glyptotermes-zhaoi/.alate: 有翅成虫头近方形，两侧及后缘中段稍直，后侧角宽圆；上颚内缘各具二枚缘齿，端齿略长于第一缘齿，左上颚第一缘齿的后缘与第二缘齿愈合，并长于第三缘齿的前缘；上唇短宽呈舌状。触角十六至十九节，第三节不大于第二节或第四节。复眼较大，突出于头壳下缘，内侧有一对单眼与之相接。后颏细长方形，前部宽阔，其后转为狭细，两侧平行，腰部近中。前胸背板横长方形，短宽，两侧中后部略宽，宽度大于头壳，前缘中央有宽弧形凹口，后缘中央略凹而较窄。前翅鳞大，前缘突出，覆于后翅鳞之上；径分脉具五至六条分支，亚前缘脉较短，径脉伸达不足全长之半或近半，约为亚前缘脉的两倍长；中脉骨化，出自翅鳞内的径分脉，走向靠近并平行于径分脉，直至翅端；肘脉约有十条分支。后翅中脉骨化，出自翅鳞外的肘脉，距基部较远或缺失，靠近径分脉，肘脉具二至四条分叉分支。足细长，胫节距式三比三比三，爪间有爪间突，尾须二节。
/species/glyptotermes-zhaoi/.en: Alate. Head nearly square, the sides and the middle of the hind margin rather straight, the posterior corners broadly rounded. Each mandible bears two marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the first, whose posterior edge in the left mandible fuses with the second. Antennae sixteen to nineteen segmented. Eyes large and projecting beyond the lower margin of the head, with a pair of ocelli touching them medially. Pronotum transversely rectangular and short, wider than the head, with a broad arcuate notch in the middle of the fore margin. Wings with a large fore scale overlapping the hind one, the radial sector giving five or six branches. The soldier is known mainly from its colour pattern, the head being yellowish brown and the mandibles blackish.
/species/glyptotermes-zhaoi/.soldier: 兵蚁头壳黄褐，后部稍淡；上颚黑褐，上唇与触角白黄，后颏淡黄褐而两侧具褐色边缘；前胸背板、足及腹部背板淡黄，全身被毛稀疏。

/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.alate: 有翅成虫体长十二至十三点五毫米，通体褐色，头与翅基色泽更深。头近圆形，触角二十一至二十六节。左上颚具端齿与三枚缘齿，颚齿板短；右上颚端齿粗大，亚缘齿小，第一缘齿短，第二缘齿呈斜切状，颚齿板相应较长。前胸背板稍窄于头宽，近前缘两侧各有一处黑褐色凹陷；前翅鳞略大于后翅鳞。腹部背面可见十节，以第七腹板最宽，将其揭开可见一枚八字形骨片；雌虫第九腹板内侧的骨片或为退化的产卵瓣，雄虫同节则生一对不分节的短刺突；第十节基部两侧各有一根五节的尾须。
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.biology: 寄主植物记录有黄山松、福建柏、杉、柳杉、木荷与米饭花。
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.distribution: 国内见于四川合江，湖南郴州与新宁，云南屏边，贵州梵净山、雷公山，广西大瑶山、龙胜，广东连山、广州、始兴，江西，福建武夷山，浙江龙泉与庆元（海拔九百至一千三百米）以及海南五指山；国外分布于越南和日本。
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.en: Soldiers are large, flat-headed termites: the front of the head is blackish, the rear reddish brown, and the pronotum is half-moon shaped, slightly narrower than the head, with a conspicuous median notch behind. Mandibles are stout, the left bearing four irregular teeth and the right two, and the antennae have 22 to 24 bead-like segments. Alates measure 12 to 13.5 mm, are brown with darker head and wing bases, have a nearly circular head, 21 to 26 antennal segments, and two dark depressions near the front of the pronotum.
/species/hodotermopsis-sjostedti/.soldier: 头前部近黑，向后转为赤褐，上唇与触角褐黄，上颚纯黑；胸与足黄色而杂有褐色，腹部乳白，可隐约透见消化道中的褐色物质。头略呈方卵形，平扁，最宽处在后端或后端与中段之间，自此向前收窄，后缘向后弓成圆弧，头顶平，正中下陷成一小坑。上唇两侧圆，前缘稍直，眼点呈肾形。上颚粗壮，左右近对称，端部尖并向中线弯曲，左上颚生四枚形状不规整的大齿，齿基彼此相连，右上颚仅二枚大齿，第一枚顶端常带三角形尖。触角二十二至二十四节，除首节外皆作念珠状，第二至第四节近等长，其后稍增粗，末端四五节渐小。前胸背板窄于头，平扁如半月，前缘略后凹，侧缘与后缘连成半圆，后缘中央缺口明显；中胸、后胸背板等宽，均窄于前胸。跗节背观四节，腹观五节；尾须三至五节，刺突细长。

/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.book_name: 大勐龙须白蚁 Hospitalitermes damenglongensis
/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.en: The soldier reaches medium size with a pear-shaped head widest behind the antennae, a strongly raised rear cranium, and a cylindrical nasus about half the head length whose apex turns upward. A single long spine stands on the mandible. Antennae have 14 segments, the third two to three times the second. Workers are reddish brown with a rounded head bearing a Y-shaped suture and a distinct dot-like fontanelle, 15-segmented antennae, and a saddle-shaped pronotum with a small median notch behind.
/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.soldier: 体中型，头呈梨状，长度略胜于宽度，触角以后的两侧显著内收，最宽处偏于头之后段，后缘成宽弧形并微微外凸；侧观头后部甚隆起，近象鼻基部明显低凹。象鼻圆柱形，长约当头长之半，端部上翘，下缘与唇基相交几成直角，额腺管可见。上颚具一尖刺，刺较长。触角十四节，第三节为第二节的二至三倍，第四节约当第二节的二倍。前胸背板呈马鞍状，前叶明显短于后叶，前缘宽阔而平直，两侧缘向后急速收窄，后缘窄而作圆弧前凸。足较长，后足腿节可达或超过腹端，胫节瘦长，距列二比二比二，跗节四节。
/species/hospitalitermes-damenglongensis.worker: 头赤褐，前部较浅，上唇浅黄褐，触角浅于头后部，前胸背板同头色，腿节赤褐，胫节黄褐。头部具微短毛，上唇有数对长短毛，胸腹背板毛稀少而腹板较密。体中型，头近圆形，触角之后最宽，后缘呈圆弧，后唇基隆起，前缘平直而后缘弓形，中央有纵沟，其长短于宽之半；头顶具Y形缝线，囟明显，作圆点状。触角十五节，第三节长于第四节，约为第二节的一点五倍。前胸背板马鞍形，前叶斜翘，与后叶几等长，后缘中央有小缺刻。小工蚁体部形态与毛序均似大工蚁，体色较浅，触角十五节，第二、三、四节近等长。

/species/hospitalitermes-jinghongensis/.en: Only a short comparative diagnosis is preserved for this species: it is small and pale, the antennae have 15 segments with the third 1.5 times the second, and the hind femora do not reach the abdominal apex. The head measures about 1.29 mm to the labrum tip, 1.13 mm wide, and the pronotum 0.67 mm across. No full caste description survives in the source, so no morphological account is given here. The species is known only from Jinghong, Yunnan.

/species/hospitalitermes-majusculus/.en: This name rests on a short comparative diagnosis only: the form is small and pale, the antennae have 15 segments with the third 1.5 times as long as the second, the head measures 1.27 to 1.39 mm to the labrum tip, 1.13 to 1.20 mm wide, and the pronotum 0.72 to 0.74 mm across. Because the original description of each caste is missing from the preserved text, none is summarized here. The species is recorded from Damenglong and Baka in Yunnan.

/species/hypotermes-bawanensis/.distribution: 云南保山坝湾（海拔九百七十五米）。
/species/hypotermes-bawanensis/.en: This species is known from Bawan, Baoshan, Yunnan, at an elevation of 975 metres. The original description in the Chinese Fauna volume provides no soldier, alate or worker morphology for it, so no caste description can be given here. Its placement in Hypotermes follows the book treatment. Further material is needed before the diagnostic characters of the soldier, the winged reproductive and the worker can be characterised, and the biology of the colony remains unrecorded.

/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.distribution: 云南盈江曼允（海拔七百三十米）。
/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown tinged with fuscous, paler on the anterior quarter. The mandibles are reddish brown with yellowish brown bases, the labrum yellowish brown, the pronotum pale yellow and the abdomen and legs milky white. Long hairs are scattered over the head, with eight pairs of setae on the labrum. The head is nearly oval, widest at the middle and highest at the mid dorsum. The left mandible has three marginal teeth and two or three serrations above the first, the right one serrate above the base.
/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.soldier: 头黄褐而带烟色，前部四分之一较浅；上颚赤褐，基部三分之一为黄褐；上唇黄褐，触角黄褐微带烟色；前胸背板浅黄，腹部与足乳白。头部散生较长的毛；上唇自端至基部两侧纵列八对毛；前胸背板周缘另有数根长毛。头近卵圆形而以中部最宽，头顶背面中部隆起最高。上唇矛形，中部隆起。上颚前端内弯：左上颚内缘中部有三枚缘齿，第一缘齿上方另有二至三枚锯齿状小齿，基部具一小尖突；右上颚基部以上有锯齿状小齿，基部具一小尖突。后颏隆起，最宽处在中部稍后。触角十六节，第四节最短，第二节为第四节的二倍。前胸背板前部略翘起，前后缘中央凹入。
/species/hypotermes-manyunensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于壤白蚁属，本站现按地白蚁属收录，属名有所变更。

/species/hypotermes-meiziensis/.distribution: 云南保山梅子树村（海拔九百一十五米）。
/species/hypotermes-meiziensis/.en: The mandibles bear serrations below the middle and curve slightly inward at the base. The postmentum is widest at its middle. Antennae have sixteen segments, the fourth being the shortest and the second about twice its length. The anterior lobe of the pronotum is constricted at the middle, and both the front and hind margins are incised at the centre. The species is recorded only from Meizishu village, Baoshan, Yunnan, at 915 metres; no alate or worker caste is described in the original account.
/species/hypotermes-meiziensis/.soldier: 上颚自中部向下可见锯齿状的缺刻，基部稍有内弯；后颏以中部为最宽处；触角共十六节，其中第四节最短，第二节的长度约当第四节的二倍；前胸背板前叶在中部狭缩，前缘与后缘的中央均向内凹入。

/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.distribution: 云南瑞丽畹町（海拔八百五十五米）。
/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown tinged with fuscous, with reddish brown mandibles whose basal third is paler. The labrum is yellowish brown, the pronotum pale yellow, and the abdomen and legs milky white. Long hairs are scattered over the vertex, and eight pairs of setae line the labrum. The head is oval, widest behind the middle. The labrum is tongue shaped with a slightly pointed tip. The left mandible has three marginal teeth plus serrations, the right one serrate from base to middle.
/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.soldier: 头黄褐微带烟色，上颚赤褐而基部三分之一色浅，上唇黄褐，触角黄褐微带烟色，前胸背板浅黄，腹部与足乳白。头背面散生长毛，上唇两侧自端至基部纵列八对毛，前胸背板周缘散生数根长毛。头卵圆形，最宽处在中部稍后，背面中部最高。上唇舌形，端部稍尖圆，中部微隆。左上颚有三枚缘齿，第一缘齿上方另有二至三枚锯齿状小齿，基部内凹处具一小尖突；右上颚基部有二小尖突，自基部至中部的内凹处呈锯齿状。后颏短粗而隆起。触角十五节，第三节最短，第二节为第三节的二倍。前胸背板前部翘起，前后缘均凹入。
/species/hypotermes-ruiliensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于壤白蚁属，本站现按地白蚁属收录，属名有所变更。

/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.distribution: 国内记录于广西与云南盈江蛮允；国外见于印度尼西亚的苏门答腊。
/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.en: The soldier head and antennae are brownish yellow, the abdomen pale yellow. Hairs are very sparse on the head but denser on the abdomen. The head is elliptical, widest at the middle, flattened above in profile with its highest point at the vertex; the postmentum projects strongly. The mandibles are sickle shaped: the left has two or three triangular notches behind the middle, the right several indistinct notches. The labrum is narrow in front with rounded sides and marginal hairs. Antennae have sixteen segments, the third and fourth shortest.
/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.soldier: 头与触角棕黄，腹部淡黄。头部毛甚稀少，而腹部毛则较密。头部呈椭圆形，以中部为最宽，侧面观其背面扁圆，最高点位于头顶中央；后颏显著突出，后部较宽。上颚镰刀状：左上颚内缘在中点以后有二至三个三角形缺刻，中点之前有时有数个小突起连成锯面状；右上颚后段有数个小缺刻，但不甚明显。上唇前端狭，侧缘圆，边缘纵列长毛。触角十六节，第三、四节最短，第四节有时短于第三节。前胸背板前后缘中央均凹入。
/species/hypotermes-sumatrensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于壤白蚁属，本站现按地白蚁属收录，属名有所变更。

/species/hypotermes-wandingensis/.distribution: 云南畹町（海拔七百八十米）。
/species/hypotermes-wandingensis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown, the mandibles reddish brown, the labrum yellowish brown, and the antennae yellowish brown tinged with fuscous. The pronotum is pale yellow, the abdomen and legs milky white. Long hairs are scattered over the head, and the labrum carries eight pairs of setae in longitudinal rows. The head is nearly oval, widest slightly behind the middle. The left mandible has three marginal teeth, the right one fine serrations; both have a small basal process.
/species/hypotermes-wandingensis/.soldier: 头黄褐，上颚赤褐，上唇黄褐，触角黄褐并微带烟色，前胸背板浅黄，腹部与足乳白。头部散生较长的毛，上唇自端部至基部纵列八对毛。头近卵圆形，最宽处在中部稍后；上唇矛形。左上颚具三枚缘齿，右上颚在中部后方有细锯齿；两上颚基部各有一枚小尖突。后颏甚为隆起，其长约为宽的一点五倍。触角十六节，第四节最短，第二节约为第四节的二倍。前胸背板前部略翘起，两侧宽圆，前缘与后缘中央均凹入。

/species/hypotermes-wayaoensis/.distribution: 云南保山瓦窑（海拔一千四百三十米）。
/species/hypotermes-wayaoensis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown, the mandibles reddish brown, the labrum yellow and the antennae yellow tinged with fuscous. The pronotum is pale yellow, the abdomen and legs milky white. Long hairs are scattered over the head, and seven pairs of setae stand in rows along the labrum. The head is nearly oval, widest at the middle. The labrum is tongue shaped with a blunt, slightly convex tip. The left mandible bears three marginal teeth and a small basal process, the right two small basal processes.
/species/hypotermes-wayaoensis/.soldier: 头黄褐，上颚赤褐，上唇黄，触角黄而带烟色，前胸背板浅黄，腹部与足乳白。头部散生长毛，上唇自端部至基部两侧纵列七对毛。头近卵圆形，最宽处在中部；上唇舌形，端部钝圆，两侧微微弧出。左上颚有三枚缘齿，基部具一小尖突；右上颚基部具二小尖突。后颏最宽处在基部四分之一。触角十六节，第四节最短，第二节为第四节的约一点五倍长。前胸背板前部略上翘，前缘较狭缩，中央呈小V形凹入，后缘微凹。

/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.alate: 头宽卵形，囟明显而略高起，单眼颇大；后唇基隆起，长约当宽之半，后缘弓形，前缘平直；触角十九节，第三节长于第二节。中、后胸背板后端呈浅弓形凹入。翅的径脉稍稍伸出翅鳞之外；前翅的中脉在肩缝处单独伸出，后翅的中脉则大多起自径分脉的基部。蚁后的腹部侧壁上并无密布的色点。
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.distribution: 云南盈江曼允（海拔七百四十米）。
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown tinged with fuscous, the mandibles reddish brown with paler bases. Nine pairs of setae line the labrum. The head is nearly oval, widest at the middle. The left mandible has three marginal teeth, the second and third separated by a deep notch, with two or three serrations above the first; the right is serrate behind the middle. The postmentum is longer than wide. Antennae have sixteen segments. Workers occur in two or three size classes, have seventeen antennal segments, and the alate has nineteen.
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.soldier: 头黄褐微带烟色，上颚赤褐而基部浅于前段，上唇黄褐，触角黄褐带烟色，前胸背板淡黄，腹部与足乳白。头部散生数根长毛，上唇两侧自端至基部纵列九对毛，前胸背板周缘仅有数根毛。头近卵圆形，中部最宽，背面最高处在中部稍前。上唇矛形，中部微隆。左上颚内缘三枚缘齿，第二、三齿间凹刻深，第一缘齿上方有二至三枚锯齿状小齿；右上颚内缘中部后方呈锯齿状；左右上颚基部各有一小尖突。后颏长大于宽。触角十六节，第四节最短，第二节约为第三节的一点五倍。前胸背板前半部稍狭缩，前后缘中部内凹。
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于壤白蚁属，本站现按地白蚁属收录，属名有所变更。
/species/hypotermes-yingjiangensis/.worker: 工蚁通常有大、小两类体形，也有大、中、小三类者。头两侧平行或前部狭窄，额部平坦，囟呈点状；上唇中部最宽，前端有一透明小块。上颚弯曲如镰刀，左上颚基部有数枚缺刻并具明显基齿，其余部分无齿，右上颚除基齿外亦无齿。触角十七节，第三节往往长于第二节。前胸背板马鞍形，前缘与后缘皆具缺刻。

/species/incisitermes-inamurai/.en: The soldier has a yellowish brown head, a rectangular capsule with a slightly convex dorsal margin, and jet-black mandibles whose outer edge is square and whose tip curves inward. The left mandible carries three teeth, the third broad and bilobed at its apex, with a small tooth-like process between the second and third; the right has two stout triangular teeth. The very short labrum is square and twice as wide as long, and the antennae have 15 segments. The rectangular pronotum is wider than the head.
/species/incisitermes-inamurai/.soldier: 头部黄褐，上唇、触角与前胸背板黄，上颚漆黑，基部褐色。头长方形，背缘稍隆起。上颚外缘方形，端部向内弯；左上颚三齿，前面二齿尖锐，第三齿宽，齿顶分为二叶，第二、第三齿的基部之间有一小型齿状突；右上颚二齿，粗壮，呈三角形。上唇极短，前缘方形，宽为长的两倍。触角十五节，基节柱形，中部较狭，第二节与第四节等长，第三节倒圆锥形，前端显著增粗；复眼痕迹明显。前胸背板四边形，宽于头，前缘强烈向后凹，后缘近直而中部略内凹，侧缘弓形，后侧角宽圆，前侧角方形。胫节三枚端齿，其中二枚朝下，一枚朝外。原书记载兵蚁有大、小两型，形态差别很小。
/species/incisitermes-inamurai/.taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于木白蚁属 Kalotermes，学名作 Kalotermes inamurae，现归入楹白蚁属 Incisitermes。

/species/incisitermes-minor/.alate: 头棕黄，复眼黑褐，单眼色淡，上唇灰白，触角第三节深褐而其余各节色淡；胸棕黄，足黄，翅棕色而透明。头近圆形，长与宽几乎相等；复眼近圆，突出；单眼略圆，不与复眼接触。触角细长，十五至二十节，第三节略长于第二、第四节，末端五、六节较粗，端节较小，卵圆形。前胸背板一般比头稍宽，有时几乎等宽，前缘中央有凹口，后缘稍平。端距式三比三比三，跗节四节。
/species/incisitermes-minor/.distribution: 国内记录于江苏南京、上海与浙江宁海；国外见于美国的加里福尼亚、亚利桑那以及墨西哥。
/species/incisitermes-minor/.en: Soldiers have an elongate head capsule whose forehead rises above the rest as twin peaks, an inclined or steeply rising frons that may be coarsely wrinkled, smooth or punctate, and short antennae of 10 to 12 segments. The mandibles are short and stout with several distinct marginal teeth, and the pronotum is broad and flat. Alates are yellowish brown with a round head, prominent eyes, 15 to 20 antennal segments, and a pronotum nearly as wide as the head.
/species/incisitermes-minor/.soldier: 头壳长形，额顶常高出于其余部分，形成双峰；额面或倾斜，或陡立，其皱纹有的粗深，有的光滑，或仅具刻点。触角短，多为十至十二节。上颚短而粗壮，与头长相比远短于新白蚁属，缘齿数枚，清晰可辨，颚基峰或明显或平坦。上唇多为方形。前胸背板平宽，腿节不肥厚；端距式三比三比三，跗节四节。

/species/indotermes-hainanensis/.en: The soldier is medium sized, with a large, hypognathous head that is almost rectangular, slightly narrower than long and faintly notched behind. The labrum is ligulate with a broadly rounded tip. Mandibles are very stout, broad at the base, strongly incurved at the tip, each with one wide marginal tooth near mid-length. The postmentum is long and flat, about twice as long as its greatest width. Antennae have 14 segments; the pronotum carries an erect saddle-shaped front lobe much longer than the rear lobe.
/species/indotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: 体形中等。头较大，下口式，接近长方形，宽度略小于长度（不含上颚）；前端稍狭，中部较宽，后缘中央微向内凹；侧面观之，头背的最高点位于中部。上唇舌状，基部宽，端部稍收狭，顶端宽圆。上颚粗壮显著，基部的半段较宽，外缘向外突出，端部的半段较狭，顶端明显内弯；左上颚内缘近中部生一枚较宽的缘齿，齿端朝向内侧，其前缘平直并与齿端同处一水平；右上颚内缘亦有一枚同样宽的缘齿。后颏长而平坦，长度略小于最宽处的两倍，最宽处在前端中部，其宽度约为腰部最窄处的两倍。触角十四节，第二与第四节等长，第三节最长。前胸背板前叶竖立如马鞍，明显长于后叶，前叶前缘中央突出，后叶后缘中央有清楚的凹口。胫节距二比二比二，跗节三节。
/species/indotermes-hainanensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于华白蚁属 Sinotermes，现归入印白蚁属 Indotermes。

/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.alate: 头、胸、腹棕褐，前唇基白色，后唇基棕褐，上唇、上颚、触角、足与翅棕黄。全身密被细毛，翅面则光滑无毛。头卵圆形，短而宽；复眼大小中等，单眼椭圆，单眼与复眼之间的距离约等于单眼的长度。后唇基隆起很高，纵长不到宽度的一半，前缘平直，后缘作楔形向后伸；前唇基与后唇基等长。囟是大形圆坑，位于头顶正中。触角十五节，第二、三、四节约等长。前胸背板前缘的中段近于平直，两侧端略向前伸，中央微凹。前翅径分脉贴近前缘伸至翅尖附近，没有显著分支；中脉在肩缝处独立伸出，位于径分脉与肘脉之间，中段之后分为数支抵达翅尖；肘脉约有十条分支。后翅中脉在肩缝处与径分脉合并伸出，同样介于二者之间，其余脉序与前翅一致。
/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.distribution: 广东东海岛与砌洲岛，海南那大，云南金平猛喇（四百三十米）、普洱（一千三百五十米）、墨江（一千四百米）、景洪（五百米）、勐罕与怒江坝。
/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.en: The soldier is dark reddish brown with a flattened, roughly rectangular head, stout mandibles whose bases are broad and flat, and one triangular inner tooth on each mandible near mid-length. Antennae have 14 segments, the second shorter than or equal to the third. The pronotum is narrow, the front lobe erect and semicircular, the rear lobe trapezoidal. Alates are brownish, densely hairy but with smooth wings; the head is oval, the postclypeus strongly arched, and the forewing media runs between the radial sector and the cubitus.
/species/indotermes-isodentatus/.soldier: 头部暗赤褐；上颚前半段黑，后半段与头同色；上唇中部亦与头同色；胸部与腹部褐色，腹面较淡，足淡黄。头部满布短绒毛，其间杂有少量长毛；胸与腹部长短毛相间。头略作长方形，扁柱状而粗大，两侧近乎平行，后端稍狭，后缘微作弧形凸出。上唇小，前端钝圆，前缘与两侧无色透明。上颚粗壮，基部扁宽，左右上颚中部各生一枚三角形的内缘大齿。触角十四节，第二节短于第三节或与之等长，第三节等于或长于第四节。后颏作长条状，中部偏后稍收狭。前胸背板很狭，前叶直立而呈半圆形，后叶为梯形，后缘微向内凹。

/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.distribution: 云南潞西勐戛，海拔一千三百八十米。
/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.en: In the soldier the head is brown, slightly longer than wide, nearly parallel-sided, broadest behind, highest at the middle, with a longitudinal suture reaching one third of the head length and a pale patch in front. The labrum is ligulate and transparent at the edge. Mandibles are very stout with a wavy outer swelling; the left inner edge bears a blunt tooth, the right a triangular one. Antennae have 14 segments and the postmentum is narrow and long, narrowest behind the middle.
/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.soldier: 头部棕褐，上颚基部黄褐而中部至端齿赤褐，上唇与触角浅黄，前胸背板与头同色，足浅黄。头部满布细毛并疏生长毛，后颏生短毛而前段夹杂长毛，胸与腹部除短毛外还有许多长毛。体形中等，头长略大于宽，两侧近于平行，最宽处约在后方，最高处位于中部，后侧角宽圆，后缘近于平直；头背纵缝由后缘中央前伸至头长的三分之一。上唇舌状。上颚十分粗壮，基部扁宽膨大，外缘有明显波状隆起；左上颚内缘近中部有一枚钝形缘齿，右上颚内缘中部为三角形缘齿，齿端斜向内方。触角十四节，第三节长于第二节。后颏狭长，最狭部位在后半部。前胸背板马鞍形，前叶垂直立于后叶之上，前叶前缘狭圆，后叶后缘中央微凹。胫节距二比二比二，跗节三节。
/species/indotermes-luxiensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于华白蚁属 Sinitermes，现归入印白蚁属 Indotermes。

/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部密被短绒毛，并散生长毛。头近圆形，宽度略大于长度（不计上颚）；囟明显，位置稍近后端；Y 缝不显。复眼大而突出，常呈圆形；单眼宽卵形，与复眼相距较近。后唇基隆起，长度略短于宽度之半，前缘较平，后缘作弧形凸出；前唇基近乎梯形；上唇呈屋顶状，前缘圆弧。触角十五节。前胸背板比头稍狭，前缘增厚，后缘中央有明显的三角形凹口。前后翅已脱落，前翅鳞长于后翅鳞。胫节距三比二比二，跗节三节。
/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.distribution: 云南潞西勐戛，海拔一千三百七十五米。
/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.en: Soldiers have a head slightly longer than wide, widest behind the middle, with two wave-like swellings on the outer base of the left mandible and one triangular marginal tooth on each mandible near mid-length. The postmentum is broad, short and flat, narrowest at the middle, and antennae have 14 segments. The pronotum stands erect as a long half-ellipse, deeply notched between lobes. Alates have a round head, prominent eyes, a roof-like labrum and a thickened pronotal front margin.
/species/indotermes-menggarensis/.soldier: 头与上颚基部黄褐，自内缘齿至端齿转为赤褐；上唇与触角浅黄；前胸背板比头色略浅。头部覆稀疏细毛，上唇末端至唇基之间有几对长毛，上颚基部具短毛，后颏前段散生少量长毛；胸部与腹部长短毛相间。头长稍大于宽，上颚基部略收狭，最宽处在中部偏后；从侧面看，头背最高点靠近后端，后缘微作弧形。上唇舌状，端部稍狭，边缘透明。上颚粗壮，基部扁宽，左上颚自外侧基部至中段有两个波状隆起，近中部有一枚三角形缘齿，右上颚近中部亦有一枚三角形缘齿。后颏宽短而平坦，中部最狭。触角十四节，第二节略短于第三节，第三、四节等长。前胸背板呈长半椭圆形并直立，前后叶交接处深凹，后叶宽于前叶。胫节距二比二比二，跗节三节。

/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.alate: 体形较小，头部厚而略隆起；复眼很小，囟明显；后唇基比额部宽，表面较平坦，长度短于宽度的一半；上唇宽大于长；触角十五至十六节。前胸背板长于其宽度的一半。前翅鳞略长于后翅鳞，翅面具细密的刻点；前翅的中脉在肩缝处独立伸出，后翅的中脉则由径分脉分出，中脉的位置靠近肘脉。胫节距三比二比二。
/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.en: Soldiers are relatively large and pale, the head yellowish brown and nearly rectangular with almost parallel sides, distinctly longer than wide and highest at mid-length. Mandibles are very stout with swollen bases, strongly incurved tips and one wide marginal tooth on each inner edge; antennae have 15 segments, the third the shortest. The pronotum is saddle-shaped with a tall front lobe. Alates are small with thick heads, minute eyes, 15 or 16 antennal segments, and forewings slightly longer than the hindwing scales.
/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: 体色较淡，头部褐黄，胸部与腹部背板淡褐。头部密布细绒毛，并散生较长毛；前胸背板密布绒毛，另有少量分散长毛；腹部背板与腹板都密生绒毛。体形较大，头接近长方形，两侧几乎平行，宽度明显短于长度（不计上颚）；从侧面看，头背最高点位于中部。上唇舌状而较宽，两侧近乎平行，宽稍胜于长。上颚相当粗壮，基部膨大而外缘向外鼓出，末端显著内弯，内缘近中部有一枚较宽的缘齿，齿端指向内方。后颏较大，长度略大于最宽处的两倍；最宽处靠近前端，最狭处靠近后端。触角十五节，第二与第四节等长，第三节最短。前胸背板前叶高高竖立，作马鞍形，明显长于后叶；前叶前缘较平，后叶后缘中央微凹。胫节距三比二比二，跗节三节。
/species/indotermes-yunnanensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于华白蚁属 Sinotermes，现归入印白蚁属 Indotermes。

/species/macrotermes-acrocephalus/.en: The major soldier has a yellowish brown head tinged with red. The head is oblong, about one and a third times as long as wide, with a broadly rounded hind margin and a mound like dorsal profile; the fontanelle lies behind the highest point. The labrum is awl shaped with a triangular hyaline tip. The mandibles are stout, about half the head length, the left bearing faint teeth and several basal notches. Antennae have seventeen segments. The postmentum is about four times as long as wide.
/species/macrotermes-acrocephalus/.soldier: 大兵头黄褐带红，胸、腹背板黄褐。头长圆形，长约为宽的一点三倍，后缘宽圆；侧观头背缘呈丘状拱起，囟位于高点之后，后颏突出；上唇矛状，唇端半透明区呈三角形；上颚颇壮，长约当头壳之半，左上颚内缘中段有不清楚的细齿，近颚基处有数个缺刻；触角十七节，第三节稍长于第二节，复眼呈点状；后颏长约为宽的近四倍，腰区在前部三分之一，其两侧接近平行。前胸背板前后缘凹切均明显，中、后胸背板皆狭于前胸，各胸背板侧叶角状不显。小兵体色略淡，头亚长方形，囟在中点之后，上唇较狭；上颚细长，约为头壳长的三分之二，左上颚内缘中段之后具细齿；后颏长条状，长约当宽的三倍。

/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.alate: 头及胸腹暗红棕，足棕黄，翅黄，后唇基暗赤黄。头宽卵形，复眼长圆形，单眼椭圆形，其与复眼的距离小于单眼本身的宽度；头顶平，囟为极小的颗粒状突起，位于头顶中点，其前方有一龙骨状纵隆起；后唇基显著隆起，长不及宽之半，中央有纵沟；触角十九节，第三节微长于第二节，第二、四、五节等长。前胸背板前缘略向后凹，后缘狭窄，中央向前凹入，前中部有淡色十字形斑，其两侧前方有圆形或肾形淡色斑。前翅鳞略大于后翅鳞；前翅中脉在肩缝处独立伸出，距肘脉较近于径分脉，中点之后开始分支，前翅肘脉有十余根分支；后翅中脉由径分脉基部伸出或于肩缝处独立伸出，贴近肘脉延伸，中段以后分支，后翅肘脉亦有十余根分支。
/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.distribution: 国内见于广西武鸣、龙州、扶绥与云南盈江、蛮允、芒市、怒江坝、南溪、允景洪（海拔五百米）、普洱（海拔一千三百米）、金平长坡头（海拔一千米）；国外记录于缅甸与泰国。
/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.en: The major soldier has a dark reddish brown head, largest of the genus, flat and trapezoid in dorsal view, broad behind and narrow in front. The mandibles are stout and sickle shaped, the left notched beyond the middle, the right toothless. Antennae have seventeen segments. The minor soldier is much smaller but similar in colour, with a narrower head and long slender mandibles. The alate is dark reddish brown with yellow wings, nineteen antennal segments and a pale cross shaped pronotal mark.
/species/macrotermes-annandalei/.soldier: 大兵头背与腹面均暗红棕，胸、腹棕褐，上颚基部与头同色而余部黑色；头部毛极稀少，腹部毛较多。头扁平而巨大，背面观呈长梯形，后宽前狭，后缘略弯或几乎平直，侧缘曲度极小。后颏狭长并弯向腹方，囟细小。上颚粗壮呈镰刀形：左上颚中点以后有数个浅缺刻及一个较深者，前部无齿；右上颚无齿。上唇舌形，尖端半透明。触角十七节，第三节长约当第二节的一点五至二倍，并显著短于第四节。前胸背板略宽于头宽之半，前部斜向上翘，侧缘呈钝角向两侧伸展，前后缘中央均有明显缺刻，后胸背板狭于前胸，足很长。小兵体形显著为小，体色相似，头较狭长，后颏显著曲突于腹面，上颚狭长弯曲而几无齿，触角第三节长于第二及第四节，足亦很长。

/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.alate: 体色与形态均与土垅大白蚁十分相似，区别在于头与前胸背板较为短狭。
/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.distribution: 国内广泛分布于中国南方诸省与香港；国外见于越南。
/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.en: The major soldier has a deep yellow head, black mandibles and a rectangular head widest behind the middle, with a very small fontanelle on a flat dorsum sloping forward. The mandibles are sickle shaped and the labrum bears a hyaline triangular tip. Antennae have seventeen segments, the third as long as or longer than the second, with pale eye spots behind the antennal sockets. The minor soldier is much smaller and paler, with an oval head, more curved sides and relatively longer mandibles.
/species/macrotermes-barneyi/.soldier: 大兵头深黄，腹部色较淡，上颚黑色；头与前胸背板有少数直立毛，腹部背面毛少而腹面毛较多。头长方形，最宽处在后部或中部，仅前端略狭窄；囟很小，位于头中点附近；头背面相当平，自囟处渐向前下方倾斜。上颚镰刀形，上唇舌状，端部有透明三角块；触角十七节，第三节长于或等于第二节，触角窝后下方有淡色眼点。胸、足形态与前种相同。小兵体形显著为小，体色亦略浅；头卵形，侧缘比大兵更弯曲，后侧角圆；上颚相对更长，显得细长而直；触角十七节，第二节长于或等于第三节；其余形态与大兵相似。

/species/macrotermes-chebalingensis/.book_name: 车八岭大白蚁 Macrotermes chebalingensis
/species/macrotermes-chebalingensis/.en: The major soldier is yellowish brown above. The head capsule is almost trapezoid, widest behind, with a straight hind margin and a dotted fontanelle in front of the middle; in profile the dorsum arches high at the fontanelle. The labrum is awl shaped with a triangular hyaline tip. The mandibles are strong, the left retaining traces of fine teeth. Antennae have seventeen segments. The postmentum is three and three quarters as long as its waist width.
/species/macrotermes-chebalingensis/.soldier: 大兵头与胸部背面黄褐，腹背稍淡。头壳近梯形，最阔处偏后，后缘平直；囟呈点状，位于头中点之前，侧观头背缘在囟处高高拱起，额区平坦而稍凹，头底缘与后颏后段明显凸出。上唇矛状，唇端半透明区三角形；上颚强壮，前段较弯，左上颚内缘中段有细齿遗迹，颚基前有几个缺刻；触角十七节，第三节较长，第二与第四节近等，第五节较短；后颏长为腰宽的三点七八倍。前胸背板前缘中央浅缺切，后缘与中胸背板后缘中央浅凹，后胸背板后缘中央平直；前、中、后胸背板侧缘呈角状，后胸稍钝。小兵头与胸部背面鲜黄带褐，腹背淡黄；头壳介于卵形与梯形之间，最宽处在中部后方；后颏条状，长为宽的二点四五至二点七七倍；前胸背板前缘宽圆。

/species/macrotermes-choui/.en: The major soldier has a reddish brown head and deep brown thoracic and abdominal tergites. The head is subtrapezoid, about one and a third times as long as wide, with a nearly straight hind margin and a median fontanelle. The labrum is awl shaped with a pointed hyaline tip. The mandibles are strong, about half the head length, the left with distinct small teeth and three or four basal notches. Antennae have seventeen segments. The postmentum is nearly five times as long as wide.
/species/macrotermes-choui/.soldier: 大兵头褐带红，胸与腹部背板深褐。头亚梯形，长约为宽的一点三倍，后缘近平直，囟在中点；侧观头背缘与底缘均稍拱出，后颏微露；上唇矛状，唇端半透明区为尖三角形；上颚强壮，长约当头壳之半，颚端稍弯，左上颚内缘中段有清楚小齿，近颚基有三至四个缺刻；触角十七节，第三节长不及第二节的二倍，复眼点状突出；后颏的长度超过宽度的四倍，腰区在中点之前，两侧自中段起向后渐渐扩大，颏前区平滑。前胸背板的前缘大致平直，后缘中央有明显切入，侧缘宽圆；中胸比前胸宽，后胸或稍宽于前胸，或二者近等大。小兵头褐带黄，胸腹褐；头亚长方形，上唇长矛状，上颚细长而不及头壳长的三分之二，右上颚基具一小尖齿，后颏长约为宽的三倍。

/species/macrotermes-constrictus/.en: The soldier head is reddish brown, with brown thorax and abdomen. The head is subrectangular, one and a fifth to one and a third times as long as wide, with broadly rounded hind angles and a median fontanelle. The labrum is awl shaped with a triangular hyaline tip. The mandibles are stout, about half the head length, the left bearing scattered fine teeth in front and three notches behind the middle. Antennae have seventeen segments, the third slightly longer than the second.
/species/macrotermes-constrictus/.soldier: 头褐带红，胸与腹部褐。头亚长方形，长约为宽的一点二至一点三倍，后侧角宽圆，囟在中点；侧观头背缘在囟处稍拱，后颏稍突出。上唇矛状，唇端半透明区三角形。上颚强壮，长约当头壳之半，颚端稍弯；左上颚内缘前段有疏散细齿，中点后有三个缺刻。触角十七节，第三节稍长于第二节，第二与第四节近等；复眼小点状而明显突出。后颏约为其宽度的三点五倍，腰区靠近中段。前胸背板前、后缘的中央均见明显凹切；中胸与后胸背板都窄于前胸，二者的侧叶角状延展很不显著。

/species/macrotermes-declivatus/.distribution: 云南景谷（海拔八百五十至九百米）。
/species/macrotermes-declivatus/.en: The major soldier has a reddish brown head, a white anteclypeus and a pale reddish brown labrum. The head is hairless except for five labral setae. It is scoop shaped, narrow in front and widest behind the middle, with a small round fontanelle in the front half. The labrum is longer than wide with a hyaline arrow like tip. The mandibles are long and stout, the left finely serrate and the right toothless. Antennae have seventeen segments, the third longer than the second.
/species/macrotermes-declivatus/.soldier: 大兵头赤褐，前唇基白，上唇淡赤褐，触角色浅，上颚除基部深赤褐外余呈黑色，前胸背板褐，中、后胸背板色略浅，足浅，腹部淡褐。头部无毛，仅上唇沿侧缘有五枚毛，后颏前部两侧二枚，前胸背板前后缘及前侧角有少量刚毛。头箕形，前部狭，最宽处在后半，后缘中央略拱；囟小而圆，位于前半部；复眼微小而呈点状；前唇基膜质。上唇长大于宽，端部透明呈箭头状；上颚长而粗大，端部内弯，左上颚具细锯齿，右上颚无齿；后颏长，前部侧边凸出，中、后部略平行；触角十七节，第三节长于第二节，第二节最短。前胸背板宽为长的二倍，前后缘中央均有切刻，侧叶明显而狭圆。中兵头略呈赤褐，上唇赤褐，腹部淡赤褐；小兵体色最浅，上唇每侧四枚毛，上颚细长。

/species/macrotermes-denticulatus/.distribution: 云南小勐仑、海南兴隆、广西凭祥。
/species/macrotermes-denticulatus/.en: Soldiers occur in two sizes, both with a red-brown head, black mandibles and pale brown thoracic and abdominal terga. The head is oblong, widest medially, with wavy lateral margins; the left mandible bears a row of fine serrations, and the antennae have 17 segments, the third one and a half times the second. The pronotum is notched on both margins and the thoracic corners end in angular lobes; minor soldiers are paler, with an oval head and slender straight mandibles.
/species/macrotermes-denticulatus/.soldier: 大兵头壳红棕，上颚纯黑而颚基红褐，胸腹背板淡褐，足黄白；毛被极稀，仅上唇两侧存数根刚毛，胸节侧角的角尖刚毛亦缺。头近长方形，前窄中宽，侧缘微作波状，后缘近平；左上颚内缘中段列生小锯齿；上唇宽舌形，除透明端外长宽约等，端钝；后颏前段收缩，腰部之上较宽，其下渐狭而平行；触角十七节，第三节长于第二节一点五倍，第五节最短；囟居头之中部偏前。前胸背板前后缘凹刻均显，中胸后缘凹入清楚，后胸后缘近直，三胸节侧角皆具角叶。小兵色浅，头淡黄而胸腹尤淡，上颚褐红，几无毛；头卵圆形，中部最宽，上颚细长近直，上唇舌状而透明端圆钝，囟与眼俱不显；触角十七节，第二节略长于第三节。

/species/macrotermes-guangxiensis/.alate: 头近红棕，后唇基与单眼浅黄褐，胸部背板红棕，腹部转淡；头部疏生长毛而后缘几无毛，前胸背板前缘与侧缘亦有疏长毛，背面除不显的花斑外兼具长毛与短毛。头明显宽于长，后缘宽圆；囟在背面中央，圆形突出；复眼较大，椭圆而凸出；单眼卵圆，略凸，其至复眼的间距明显小于单眼短径；后唇基显著隆起，背面中央有一纵线，前缘具一对长毛；前唇基前缘中央微凸；上唇舌状，前缘近平；左上颚具二枚缘齿。
/species/macrotermes-guangxiensis/.en: The soldier head is nearly trapezoidal with a broadly rounded hind margin, a punctate fontanelle and small clear eye spots. Mandibles are stout and incurved, the left with a basal notch and faint teeth, the right smooth; antennae have 17 segments, the third about twice the second. The pronotum is deeply excised on both margins and the thoracic lobes are narrowly rounded. Alates are reddish brown, with a head wider than long, prominent oval eyes, oval ocelli and a raised clypeus.
/species/macrotermes-guangxiensis/.soldier: 大兵头壳近红棕，上颚黑褐而基部红褐，触角浅黄，前胸背板黄褐，中、后胸及腹转淡，头与胸背板几无毛。头近梯形，后缘宽圆，侧观背缘中部略隆；囟近中央，点状凹入，眼点小而清晰；上唇舌形，两侧中部微凸，透明区顶端较尖；上颚粗壮而端内弯，左上颚内缘基部有缺刻、中点以下细齿模糊；后颏近长方形，腰部近平行；触角十七节，第三节约为第二节两倍。前胸背板前缘深凹而具中切口，后缘亦深凹，侧叶狭圆；中胸后缘深凹，后胸后缘近直。小兵头红棕，上颚红褐，触角黄褐；头近长方形，前部略狭；眼小卵圆；上颚细直而端内弯，左上颚内缘基部具切刻而无细齿。前胸背板最宽，前缘宽圆而中央浅凹；中胸最狭；后足胫节长于头宽。

/species/macrotermes-hainanensis/.en: Soldiers have a red-brown head, blackish mandibles and a yellowish brown pronotum, the thorax and abdomen paler. The head is oblong and widest medially; mandibles are long and stout with incurved apices and edentate inner margins, and the antennae have 17 segments, the fifth short. The pronotum is the widest sclerite, distinctly notched fore and aft, with rounded anterior corners. Minor soldiers are orange-yellow with slender, nearly straight mandibles and leaf-like lateral corners.
/species/macrotermes-hainanensis/.soldier: 大兵头红棕，上颚黑褐，触角与前胸背板褐黄，中、后胸及腹淡褐黄，足黄白；上唇两侧约十根长刚毛，后唇基三至四根，胸腹背板仅疏毛。头近长方形，中部最宽，后缘平直；上颚粗壮，顶端内弯，左上颚基部数缺刻；上唇椭圆，透明端三角形而顶尖；囟在中部稍前，为褐色小点；触角十七节，第三节为第二节的一点五至二倍；后颏长，前部收缩，腰部之前最宽，以下平行而前缘最狭。前胸背板最宽，前后缘凹刻明显；中胸最窄而后缘宽凹；后胸后缘近平；前胸前侧角圆钝，中、后胸侧角尖锐。小兵头、上唇与触角橙黄，上颚红褐；上唇两侧八至十根刚毛；头近长方形而后缘近平；上颚细长较直；触角十七节，第三节几等于第二节；前胸背板前侧角宽叶形。

/species/macrotermes-incisus/.en: The soldier head is almost rectangular, slightly swollen near the middle, with an arcuate hind margin bearing a marked median excision; the postmentum bows downward in profile. Mandibles are stout and strongly incurved, the labrum broadly tongue-shaped, the fontanelle a pale dot and the eye spots indistinct. Antennae have 17 segments, the third and fourth subequal and shorter than the second. The pronotum has its front lobe shorter than the rear one, with a deep median notch behind.
/species/macrotermes-incisus/.soldier: 大兵头壳与上唇浅褐黄，上颚黑褐，触角褐，胸腹与足暗黄；毛极稀，上唇端毛之后另有五对稍长毛，胸背板几近光秃。头近矩形，近中部略膨出，后缘弧形而中央凹入；侧观背缘较平，后颏中部弓出；上颚粗而弯，端部强烈内弯；触角十七节，第三、四节近等长而皆短于第二节。前胸背板前叶短于后叶，后缘中央显著凹入；中胸最狭小而两侧角状外突；后胸略宽于中胸而狭于前胸。小兵头褐黄，上颚深褐，前胸背板浅褐黄；头近矩形而以近中部最宽；囟红色小点，眼在触角窝后下方；上唇长矛状；上颚细长而端略内弯；触角十七节，第二节长于第三节，第四节最短。前胸背板前后叶几等长，前缘凹口微小而后缘凹口明显。
/species/macrotermes-incisus/.taxonomy_note: 原书属名排作 Macrote，系 Macrotermes 的排印讹误，现仍置于大白蚁属。

/species/macrotermes-jinghongensis/.en: The soldier has a brown head tinged with red and dark brown thoracic and abdominal terga. The head is nearly oblong, about one and a quarter to one and a third times as long as wide, with a straight hind margin and a fontanelle at mid-length. Mandibles are short and stout, the left with two basal notches and indistinct median serrations; antennae have 17 segments, the third one and a half times the second. The pronotum is notched on both margins, and the meso- and metanotal lobes project as angles.
/species/macrotermes-jinghongensis/.soldier: 头褐而带红，胸与腹部背板深褐。头近长方形，长约为宽的一点二五至一点三六倍，后缘近平直；囟在中点，侧观背缘与后颏均微拱；上唇矛状，唇端半透明区呈三角形；上颚短壮，颚端稍弯，左上颚内缘中段细齿不清，近颚基处有二缺刻；触角十七节，第三节约为第二节的一点五倍；复眼点状；后颏长约当最狭处的四倍余，腰区位于中点之前，两侧自中段向后渐扩。前胸背板前后缘中央均具凹切，侧叶宽圆；中、后胸背板宽于或几等于前胸背板，其侧叶明显作角状伸出。

/species/macrotermes-longiceps/.en: The soldier head is red-brown, elongate and broadening rearward, widest behind and trapezoidal in dorsal view. Mandibles are stout with serrations on the inner margin; the labrum is oval and its long transparent apex is bluntly pointed; antennae have 17 segments. The pronotum is more deeply notched behind than in front, and all three thoracic segments end in distinct angular lobes, each corner usually bearing a long seta. Minor soldiers are yellowish with slender straight mandibles.
/species/macrotermes-longiceps/.soldier: 大兵头红棕，上颚黑褐，上唇、触角、前胸背板与腹部背板棕黄，中、后胸及足淡黄；上唇八至十根刚毛，唇基二根，胸背板二至四根。头较长，自前向后渐扩而头后最宽，背面观作等腰梯形，后缘微拱；上颚粗壮，内缘中部有锯齿，颚体较短；上唇椭圆形，中部最宽，透明区长而作三角形，顶端钝凸；触角十七节，第三节较长于第二节；囟在中部稍前，为小褐圆点；后颏长，腰部之前较宽而以下近平行。前胸背板后缘凹刻大于前缘；三胸节侧角均有明显角叶，角尖常具一长刚毛。小兵头、上唇与触角黄，上颚红棕，胸腹淡黄；头近长方形，前部稍收缩而后缘拱出；上颚细长较直而端微弯；上唇舌状，透明区三角形凸出；触角十七节，第二节稍长于第三节；囟与眼皆不显。

/species/macrotermes-longimentis/.alate: 有翅成虫头与胸深黄褐，腹部色泽稍淡；后唇基深黄，隆起明显，具毛二根；前唇基白色；上唇黄色，中段有界限不明的淡色横纹，其前后各有一色泽稍深的三角块，共具毛四根。头部被毛稀少，胸、腹毛被稍多。
/species/macrotermes-longimentis/.en: The soldier head is yellowish brown, oval and narrowed in front, with rounded posterior corners. The labrum is one and a half times as long as wide and its translucent tip is a large pentagon enclosing a small triangle. Mandibles are slender and sickle-shaped; the left carries eight notches behind mid-length, the first and third deeper, while the right is smooth except for a basal swelling. Antennae have 17 segments, the third longest and nearly twice the second.
/species/macrotermes-longimentis/.soldier: 头黄褐，触角基部、胸背板与腹部各节后半部色较深，上颚黑；头与胸毛稀少，腹节后缘毛成列，约二十余根。头近卵形，前狭后宽，侧缘圆弧出，后侧角圆；上唇长约当宽的一点五倍，端部半透明的大五角块套叠小三角块；上颚细长，镰刀形，左上颚中点之后有八缺刻，自基部数起第一、三较深，第二较宽而浅，余者微小，右上颚基部有突起而其余光滑无齿；触角十七节，第三节最长、第二节最短，第三节近为第二节的两倍而稍长于第四节。

/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.alate: 头与胸部背面黑褐，复眼黑，后唇基棕，上颚黑褐，触角深褐。复眼卵形，单眼长卵形，单眼与复眼的距离略小于单眼宽度；后唇基显著隆起，长不及宽之半，中央有一纵沟；触角十九节，第三节略长于第二节；囟细小，位于头顶中央。前胸背板平，宽约等于头宽，前缘较宽而后缘较狭，中部前后各有凹入，中央稍上方具Y形浅色斑印，左右上角与中部下方各有一圆点浅斑。前翅鳞略大于后翅鳞，前翅中脉自基部独立伸出，距肘脉较近于径分脉，并在中点之前开始分支，后翅中脉自径分脉基部稍前伸出，亦于中点前分支。
/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.en: The soldier head is brownish, widest behind the middle and narrowed forward, with rounded posterior corners and strongly curved lateral margins. Mandibles are slender and straight, the left with several wavy basal notches; antennae have 17 segments. The labrum is tongue-shaped with a white translucent tip, and two dark longitudinal stripes mark the rear of the head. Alates are dark brown, with oval eyes, elongate ocelli set closer to the eyes than the ocellar width, 19-segmented antennae and a T-shaped pale mark on the pronotum.
/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.soldier: 大兵头部褐棕，腹部背板深褐，上颚黑，头面有稀疏小毛。小兵色较浅，头棕黄，腹与足淡黄，触角棕，上颚黑，上唇棕而前端具白色透明三角尖。头最宽处在中后部，向前变狭，两后角明显变圆而侧缘弯曲较大；上颚细长挺直，仅末端稍弯，左上颚基部有若干波状缺刻，右上颚无齿；触角十七节，第二、三节长短约等；上唇舌状，前端透明三角尖，宽大于长；囟细小而尚明显，位于头顶中央；头后部有二条较短深色纵纹；后颏向外突；前胸背板较头为窄，约当头宽的三分之二，前缘有少数短毛。
/species/macrotermes-luokengensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书属名排作 Macrorermes，系 Macrotermes 的排印讹误，现仍置于大白蚁属。

/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.distribution: 西藏墨脱（海拔八百至一千一百米）、石穷山（一千米）、马尼翁（八百米）、希让（八百至一千二百米）。
/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.en: The soldier head is red-brown, longer than wide, trapezoidal and widest behind the middle, with two dark stripes running back from mid-dorsum. The postmentum is hexagonal in front and constricted at the waist; mandibles are stout, the left with several shallow notches behind mid-length, the right toothless, and the antennae have 17 segments. Minor soldiers have oval heads and sabre-like mandibles, and a parasitic form is intermediate in size with a broader head. Workers are yellow with short tongue-shaped labra.
/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.soldier: 大兵头红棕而后部稍淡，背面中部至后缘有二条黑褐纵纹，触角棕黄，上颚黑而基部红棕，胸腹背板黄褐；头几光裸，上唇两侧十枚刚毛，前胸背板四枚。头长大于宽，作长梯形，前狭后宽，最宽在中后部，后缘近直；囟点状居背面中央；后颏长，前面宽阔呈六角形，腰部内缩；上颚粗壮而前端内弯，左上颚中点以后有数个浅缺刻及一较深缺刻，右上颚无齿；上唇近三角形，近基部最宽，前端透明部塔顶状；触角十七节，第一节最长，第二节最短小而作柱形。小兵较小而色淡；头卵圆形，囟在头顶中央，后颏突出于腹面而作棍棒状；上唇狭长，尖端透明如矛；上颚直面细长，军刀状，端稍内弯；触角十七节，第五节最短。
/species/macrotermes-meidoensis/.worker: 头黄，上颚黄褐而齿暗褐；头近圆形；触角十七节，第一、二节圆柱形，第五节最短，触角窝之后有小淡色眼点；囟扁圆，居头顶中央；唇基分前后两部，前唇基小而扁平，后唇基大而高起并被中缝分成左右两半；上唇短舌形；左右上颚各具一端齿与二缘齿；前胸背板前半翘起而成马鞍形。

/species/macrotermes-menglongensis/.en: The soldier has an orange-red head, reddish brown mandibles and orange-yellow antennae, the thorax and abdomen slightly paler. The head is nearly oval with the fontanelle central and the eyes imperceptible; the labrum is almost conical with a strongly arched dorsum. Mandibles are slender and straight, the left notched at the base with faint teeth below mid-length, the right smooth; antennae have 17 segments. The pronotum is the widest sclerite, shallowly notched on both margins, with narrowly rounded lateral lobes.
/species/macrotermes-menglongensis/.soldier: 头橘红，上颚红褐而近基部色浅，触角橘黄，胸与腹部背板较头部略淡；头与胸背板仅具数根长毛。头近卵圆形，囟在头中央，眼不显，侧观背缘略拱而颏突出；上唇近锥形，背部明显拱起，近基部最宽，透明区顶端狭圆；上颚细直，颚端稍弯，左上颚内缘基部有缺刻、中点以下略具细齿，右上颚内缘光滑；后颏近长方形，腰部不显，前端最狭，两侧稍近平行；触角十七节，第三节稍长于第二或第四节。前胸背板最宽，前后缘中央均浅凹或前缘凹入不显，侧叶狭圆；中胸背板最狭，后缘中央略凹，侧叶近圆；后胸背板后缘近直，侧叶近圆。

/species/macrotermes-orthognathus/.en: The body is yellowish tinged with brown and the legs are paler. The minor soldier has an oval head one and a fifth to one and two-fifths times as long as wide, the fontanelle behind mid-length and the postmentum projecting below. Mandibles are slender, straight and pointed, more than two-thirds the length of the head capsule, the left finely toothed behind mid-length; antennae have 17 segments and the postmentum is a narrow band. The pronotum is shallowly excised on both margins and the hind tibia exceeds the head width.
/species/macrotermes-orthognathus/.soldier: 全体黄而带褐，足色稍淡。小兵头卵圆形，长为宽的一点二至一点四倍，囟在中点之后，侧观头背缘稍拱而后颏明显突出；上颚细长，长约达头壳的三分之二以上，颚端尖细而直，左上颚内缘自中点以后具细齿；触角十七节；后颏作狭条状，两侧近平行。前胸背板前后缘浅凹，前、后胸侧叶角状不显，中胸两侧近平行；后足胫节长于头宽。

/species/macrotermes-peritrimorphus/.book_name: 近三型大白蚁 Macrotermes peritrimorphus
/species/macrotermes-peritrimorphus/.distribution: 广西贺县滑水冲自然保护区。
/species/macrotermes-peritrimorphus/.en: Soldiers are yellowish brown with dark brown mandibles and a white band where the mandible bases meet the head. The head is nearly oblong, widest medially, with the left mandible smooth above mid-length and finely serrate below; the labrum is longer than wide, tongue-shaped, with a blunt translucent tip. Antennae have 17 segments. The pronotum is the widest sclerite, slightly notched in front and markedly so behind. Medium and minor soldiers are paler and less hairy, with oval heads.
/species/macrotermes-peritrimorphus/.soldier: 大兵头、上唇、触角与前胸背板黄褐，腹背板及足较淡，上颚黑褐，前唇基与颚基交接处白色；上唇中央前半段周缘约十根长刚毛，后唇基三至四根，前胸背板中区约十根，中、后胸角叶各一长刚毛。头近长方形，中间较宽而后面略窄，后缘几乎直；左上颚中段以上光滑，中段以下微细锯齿越近基部越粗；上唇舌状，长大于宽，透明端近圆三角形而钝；触角十七节，第三节稍长于第二节，第四节几等于第二节；后颏长方形，前面较宽而腰部以下较窄平行。前胸背板最宽，前缘中间微凹而后缘中央凹入显著；中胸最狭。中兵色较淡；头卵圆形，近后段三分之一处最宽；上颚较细较直；前胸背板后缘中间凹入。小兵体形更小，形似中兵而色更淡。

/species/macrotermes-planicapitatus/.en: The soldier head is brown, the thorax and abdomen darker, with the antennae darker beyond the second segment. The head narrows between the antennal sockets and the mandible bases, its sides parallel behind the sockets and its dorsum flat in profile; mandibles are stout with incurved tips, the left finely toothed behind mid-length. The labrum is narrow with an angularly produced translucent part. Antennae have 17 segments. Workers are pale yellow with sparsely haired bodies and a rectangular head.
/species/macrotermes-planicapitatus/.soldier: 大兵头棕，胸腹杂深棕而较头稍深，上颚近黑，触角基节与第二节略浅，足深黄；头胸背毛稀疏，腹背各节沿后缘列生一排毛。头于触角窝至颚基略缩狭，触角窝之后两侧平行，后缘较平；侧观背部平坦；上颚粗壮而端内弯，左上颚内缘中点之后数枚小齿、中点之前齿痕极不明显；上唇狭长，两侧近中部略宽，透明区明显而前半角状突出；囟点状居背中点之前；触角十七节，第三节狭长而长于第四节。前胸背板前片略短于后片，前缘中央凹口浅而后缘凹口略深；前、后胸两侧钝角状，中胸两侧圆角状；后足胫节略小于头宽。小兵两侧近平行而仅中部略宽；上颚细长较直；上唇狭长而透明端角状突出；触角十七节，第二节大于第三节；后颏长方形而无腰区。
/species/macrotermes-planicapitatus/.worker: 大工色深，胸腹与足明显浅于头而呈淡黄，体躯被毛稀疏，仅背部散布短毛；头最宽处在两侧近触角窝，向后圆弧缩狭，后缘狭圆；囟在背中点稍后；上唇宽舌状；后唇基略隆起而作横条状，纵缝线明显；触角十七节，第三节小于或稍大于第二节，小于或等于第四节；前胸背板明显分前后两叶，前叶稍长于后叶并竖起与后叶成直角，前缘突出部较宽而中央微凹，后缘中部宽弧突出而中央凹口较深；头长至唇端二点零四至二点二零毫米。小工头暗棕，触角深棕，体形显著小于大工，除头近圆形外与大工十分相似，头长至唇端一点四四至一点四九毫米。

/species/macrotermes-trapezoides/.en: The soldier has a brown head tinged with red and yellowish brown terga. The head is trapezoidal, about one and a third times as long as wide, with the fontanelle before mid-length and the dorsum and postmentum nearly flat in profile. Mandibles are strong, more than half the head length, with distinct median serrations; antennae have 17 segments, the third nearly twice the second. The pronotum is notched on both margins, the rear notch deeper, and the meso- and metanotal lobes project as angles.
/species/macrotermes-trapezoides/.soldier: 大兵头褐带红，胸与腹部背板黄褐。头梯形，长约为宽的一点三倍，后缘近平直；囟在中点之前，侧观头背缘与后颏均近扁，囟点处稍拱；上唇矛状，唇端半透明区钝三角形；上颚强壮，长过头壳之半，内缘中段细齿明显，近颚基有数缺刻；触角十七节，第三节近二倍于第二节；复眼小点状；后颏长约当最狭处的四倍，腰区在前部三分之一。前胸背板前后缘中央均凹切而后缘较深，前胸侧叶角状伸出不显，中、后胸侧叶角状明显；后足胫节不及头宽。小兵头黄褐，胸腹较淡；头梯形，长约为宽的一点二至一点三倍，囟在中点前，后颏强突出；上唇较大兵细狭；上颚细长，长约为头壳的三分之二，颚体较直而端甚弯；触角十七节，第二至五节近等长。

/species/macrotermes-trimorphus/.en: Soldiers are yellowish brown with black mandibles. The head is nearly oblong, the left mandible serrate near mid-length; the labrum is slightly wider than long with a pointed translucent tip; antennae have 17 segments, the third one and a half to two times the second. The pronotum is notched on both margins and all thoracic corners carry angular lobes. Medium and minor soldiers are paler, with oval heads and finer mandibles; workers are reddish brown with the pronotum tilted upright in front.
/species/macrotermes-trimorphus/.soldier: 大兵头与胸腹背板近褐黄，触角与足淡褐黄，上颚黑；上唇周缘约十根直立刚毛，后唇基二根，胸背板稀疏，腹部较稠密。头近长方形，后缘较直；左上颚近中部内缘有锯齿，越近基部齿越粗；上唇除透明端外宽稍大于长，透明端尖而宽钝；后颏前部稍宽，腰部以下平行；触角十七节，第三节为第二节的一点五至二倍；囟在中部稍前，点状不显。前胸背板前后缘中间均凹入，中胸后缘微凹，后胸后缘几平直；前胸最宽而中胸最狭，三胸节侧角均有明显角叶。中兵色似大兵而淡；头宽卵圆形，最宽近中部稍后；上颚较细直而端微内弯；前胸背板前缘无凹刻而后缘微凹。小兵似中兵而更淡；上颚更细较直；上唇长叶形；触角十七节，第二节长于第三节，第四节最短。
/species/macrotermes-trimorphus/.worker: 大工头红棕，触角、胸腹背板淡褐，足黄白，头部散生几根刚毛；头两侧缘与后缘连成半圆，中部最宽；后唇基强凸起，中有褐色纵缝分为两半；囟在中央稍前，呈淡白色三角形凹坑；触角十七至十九节，第二节等于或稍长于第三节，第四或第五节最短；前胸背板前半直立翘起而与后半几成直角，后缘凹刻宽深，前缘微凹；中胸后缘微凹，后胸后缘几平直；前胸两侧角稍有角突，中、后胸两侧角几呈弧形。中工头部淡红棕，触角十七节，第二节长于第三节，第五节最短，余与大工相似。小工头部淡黄，触角十七节，第二节可为第三节的二倍长，第三节最短，前胸背板比中胸略窄而后胸最宽。

/species/macrotermes-yunnanensis/.en: The soldier head is reddish brown and nearly trapezoidal, widest near the rear, with the dorsal margin slightly raised and the ventral margin projecting in profile. The fontanelle is a projecting dot and the eye spots are distinct and oval; mandibles are stout with curved tips, the left notched at the base and faintly toothed near mid-length. Antennae have 17 segments, the third twice the second. The pronotum is about twice as wide as long, notched on both margins, with narrowly rounded lobes.
/species/macrotermes-yunnanensis/.soldier: 大兵头红褐，上颚黑褐而基部略淡，触角红褐，胸与腹部背板黄褐。头近梯形，最宽处在近头之后部，后缘稍宽圆；侧观背缘中部略隆而下缘略下突；上唇舌形，近基部最宽，透明区顶端较尖；上颚粗壮而端弯，左上颚内缘近基部有缺刻、近中点细齿不显；后颏较狭长，腰部两侧近平行而近基部稍宽；触角十七节，第三节最长而约为第二节两倍。前胸背板与中、后胸近等宽，宽约为长的两倍，前后缘中央均凹入，侧叶狭圆。小兵头浅红褐，上颚深红褐，触角浅黄褐；头近梯形而后缘近宽圆；上唇舌形而背部稍拱；上颚较细长，端尖细而明显内弯，左上颚内缘基部具切刻；后颏近长方形；触角十六节，第三节最长；前胸背板最宽，后缘中央明显凹入。

/species/macrotermes-zhejiangensis/.alate: 体背深褐，翅黄灰，翅脉黄褐，足黄褐。头壳圆形而略扁；复眼长圆而横置；囟点状突起，居复眼后缘中央；侧观后唇基与单眼强隆起，后唇基中线褐色，宽约为长的二点五倍；触角十九节，第三节长于第二节，第四、五节最短；前胸背板前缘宽凹，两侧急斜向后，后缘近平，中央有T形淡斑，前侧角各有点斑；前翅中脉于中点之后分支不清或微弱。
/species/macrotermes-zhejiangensis/.en: The soldier head is brownish yellow, nearly trapezoidal, about one and a quarter times as long as wide, with a straight hind margin and a fontanelle at mid-length. Mandibles are short and stout, less than half the head length, the left faintly toothed medially and notched near the base; antennae have 17 segments. The pronotum and mesonotum are excised medially and the thoracic sides are angular. Alates are dark brown with a rounded, flattened head, transverse oval eyes and 19-segmented antennae.
/species/macrotermes-zhejiangensis/.soldier: 大兵头褐带黄，触角深褐而基二节色淡，胸腹背板褐，足淡褐带黄。头近梯形，长约为宽的一点二四倍，最宽约为颚基宽的两倍，后缘近平；囟在中点，侧观背缘于囟点处拱起，后颏稍突出于头底缘；上颚短壮，长不及头壳之半，左上颚内缘中段细齿不清，颚基前有数缺刻；触角十七节，第三节稍长于第二节，第二节与第四节等长；后颏长约为最狭处的四至五倍。前胸背板前后缘及中胸后缘中央均凹切，后胸后缘近平；三胸节侧缘均呈角状。小兵头胸腹背面淡褐黄，触角色深；头似近梯形，长约为宽的一点二五倍；囟在中点稍后；上颚细长，长约为头壳的三分之二，颚体较直而端稍弯；后颏似条状，前段五分之一处较宽。

/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.distribution: 云南孟连；国外见于缅甸、孟加拉、泰国与越南。
/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.en: The soldier's capsule is chestnut brown, darker on the frons, while thorax and abdomen are greyish yellow tinged with brown; long hairs are scattered over the head. The capsule is rectangular with parallel sides and a nearly straight rear margin, and the frontal peaks are slightly raised above shallow wrinkles. Antennae have 13 segments, the third shortest. The labrum is bell-shaped, the mandibles rod-like with finely serrate inner edges and deep basal notches. The pronotum is saddle-shaped with a sharply incised front margin.
/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.soldier: 头壳栗褐，深浅不一，额部颜色较深；胸部与腹部灰黄带褐。头壳上散布长毛。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘近乎平直。额峰略微隆起，额面有浅皱纹；从侧面看，额峰稍高于头后缘。触角十三节，第三节最短，略短于第二节。上唇钟形，唇端稍突出。上颚体近棒状，稍粗，颚端尖细且弯曲明显；颚内缘有细锯齿，颚基外缘的凹入角相当深；后颏中段凸出，腰区位于中段之后。前胸背板马鞍状，前缘切入明显，后缘平直。
/species/microcerotermes-crassus/.taxonomy_note: 原书属名印作 Mierocerotermes，系 Microcerotermes 之拼写讹误，现用属名与此一致。

/species/microcerotermes-marilimbus/.alate: 全体深褐，头壳较深，后唇基深褐或较淡，单眼之间的淡黄色条纹不清楚，前胸背板具淡色T纹；足黄褐。体长连翅八点五二至九点六三毫米，体长五点六八至六点六零毫米。头壳椭圆形，长稍大于宽，长零点八五至零点九二毫米，宽零点八零至零点八五毫米；囟小，丫缝不清楚。触角十四节，第三节最短，第二节为第三节的两倍。复眼突出率百分之十四，与头下缘的间距约为其长径之半强。单眼卵圆形，长约零点零七毫米，与复眼的间距几等于其长径。后唇基稍隆起，中线深色，中长零点二五至零点二七毫米。前胸背板梯形，长零点四三至零点四八毫米，宽零点七一至零点七六毫米，前缘稍翘起，后缘中央凹入明显。后胫长零点九五至一点零二毫米。
/species/microcerotermes-marilimbus/.en: The soldier has a yellowish brown head tinged with red, a darker frons and a pale yellow pronotum. The capsule is rectangular with parallel sides, visible frontal angles and a nearly straight dorsal profile; antennae have 13 segments, the third shortest. Mandibles are stout, curved sickles with fine serrations and shallow basal notches. Minor soldiers differ from majors in their slender, straighter mandibles with a coarse tooth near the basal third, shorter mandibles and flatter postmentum. Alates are dark brown with pale T-shaped pronotal markings and 14-segmented antennae.
/species/microcerotermes-marilimbus/.soldier: 头壳黄褐带红，额区稍深；触角黄色；前胸背板淡黄，腹部更淡。头壳上生有几根长毛。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘较直；额角可见，头背缘近平直。触角十三节，第三节最短，第二节长于第三节。上唇两侧平行，前缘平直或略向前收狭，具三对短刚毛。上颚镰刀状，粗而较弯；内缘锯齿在颚基之前较细，向端部渐模糊，基部外缘凹入较浅；后颏中段侧观明显凸出，腰区在后缘三分之一处；前胸背板马鞍状，前缘微切入，后缘几近平直。小型兵蚁与大型者相比，上颚细而稍直，内缘近基部三分之一处有粗齿，颚长零点七二至零点八三毫米，大型者为零点六二至零点七一毫米；后颏中段较平，头高零点八二至零点八五毫米，大型者零点八九至一点零二毫米。

/species/microcerotermes-periminutus/.en: The soldier's capsule is pale yellow, still paler on the labrum and antennae, with yellowish brown mandibles tinged with red and a whitish yellow thorax and abdomen. Pilosity is very sparse. The capsule is rectangular with parallel sides and a slightly projecting rear margin; the frons and dorsal profile are flat. Antennae have 12 segments, the second shortest. The labrum is square and the mandibles short, stout sickles with coarse inner serrations and very shallow basal notches. The postmentum bulges strongly, its broad part near the front margin.
/species/microcerotermes-periminutus/.soldier: 头壳淡黄，上唇与触角颜色更浅，上颚黄褐带红；胸部与腹部白中带黄。全身被毛十分稀疏。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘略向外突出；额部平坦，头背缘亦平。触角十二节，第二节最短，第三节稍长于第二节。上唇方形。上颚军刀状，短而粗，端部稍弯；左上颚长度约与头宽相等；颚内缘的锯齿较粗，颚基外缘的凹入很浅。后颏明显凸出，宽区靠近前缘，腰区接近后缘。前胸背板的前后缘都近乎平直。

/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.alate: 全体深褐，头壳较深，后唇基黄至黄褐，单眼之间具淡黄条纹；前胸背板有淡色T纹；足黄色。体长连翅七点四九至九点四四毫米，体长五点五五至五点八九毫米。头壳椭圆形，长稍大于宽，长零点八四至零点八七毫米，宽零点七四至零点八零毫米；囟呈小点状，头中缝隐约可见。触角十四节，第三节最短。复眼与头下缘的间距约为其长径的四分之一。单眼卵圆形，长约零点一零毫米，与复眼的间距不及其长径之半。后唇基稍隆起，中长零点二二至零点二三毫米，宽零点三七至零点四零毫米。前胸背板梯形，长零点三八至零点四六毫米，宽零点六二至零点七四毫米，前缘稍翘起，中央浅凹，后缘凹入明显。后胫长零点九四至一点零二毫米。
/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.distribution: 海南崖县、东方、乐东、陵水。
/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.en: Soldiers have a brown capsule with scattered long hairs, a rectangular outline slightly narrowed at midlength and a broadly rounded rear. Frontal peaks are faintly raised and the frons nearly smooth; antennae have 13 segments, the third shortest. Minor soldiers are paler, shorter-headed, with slender mandibles bearing a coarse tooth at the basal third. Alates are dark brown with yellowish clypeus, pale T-markings on the pronotum, 14-segmented antennae, and a trapezoidal pronotum whose hind margin is distinctly notched.
/species/microcerotermes-remotus/.soldier: 头壳褐色，胸、腹淡黄带褐。头壳生有几根分散长毛。头壳长方形，两侧平行，中段略狭，后缘宽圆；额峰稍隆，额面近平滑。侧观头背缘在额后稍凹，额顶与头后缘齐平。触角十三节，第三节最短，短于第二节。上唇扁方形，前缘多下倾。两颚作镰刀形，末端尖细并略微弯曲；内缘的锯齿大小不一，基部外缘以近乎直角的方式凹入；后颏中部并不明显外凸，腰区靠近后缘；前胸背板马鞍状，前缘浅凹，后缘平直。小型兵蚁体色较大型者淡，头壳长方形而较短，额角可见，头背缘颇平；触角十三节，第三节最短，约为第二节之半；上颚较细直，内缘近颚基三分之一处有粗齿，向前渐细；后颏中段凸出亦不明显。

/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.alate: 全体深褐，头壳较深，后唇基淡褐，单眼之间有两道长条形的淡斑；前胸背板具淡色T纹；足腿节淡黄褐，胫节色深。体长连翅六点三九至七点一七毫米，体长五点六八至六点六零毫米。头壳卵圆形，宽稍大于长，长零点七三毫米，宽零点七七至零点七八毫米；囟小，中缝可见。触角十三节，第三节最短。复眼与头下缘的间距小于长径的三分之一。单眼卵圆形，长约零点零五毫米，与复眼的间距约等于其长径。后唇基稍隆起，中线深色，中长零点一九至零点二零毫米，宽零点三二至零点三四毫米。前胸背板梯形，长零点三七至零点三九毫米，宽零点五八至零点五九毫米，前缘稍翘起，后缘中部凹入。后胫长零点七一至零点七三毫米。
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.biology: 在草根下营造黑褐色菱角状或各种圆形的硬壳巢，直径约三至六厘米；尚未见造成危害损失，对改良土壤可能有益。
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.distribution: 广东广州、珠海、台山、电白、湛江、海康、徐闻，以及海南、广西南宁、浦北、合浦。
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.en: Soldiers are yellowish brown with a pale yellowish white body. The capsule is rectangular, parallel-sided or narrowing behind, with dot-like frontal angles; antennae have 13 segments, the third half as long as the second. The labrum is bell-shaped with three pairs of short setae, and the stout sabre-like mandibles carry both fine and coarse serrations plus a coarse tooth near the basal third. Alates are dark brown with two elongate pale patches between the ocelli and a trapezoidal pronotum with pale T-markings.
/species/microcerotermes-rhombinidus/.soldier: 头壳黄褐，胸、腹淡黄白。头壳被毛适中。头壳长方形，两侧平行或向后渐狭，后缘近直；两额角呈点状突起；头背缘较平。触角十三节，第三节最短，为第二节之半。上唇钟状，具三对短刚毛。上颚军刀状，粗壮而端部弯曲；颚内缘兼有细锯齿与粗锯齿，近颚基三分之一处有一枚粗齿，颚基外缘凹入甚浅；后颏平坦，宽区位于前段三分之一处，腰区近后缘；前胸背板马鞍状，前缘中央稍凹入，后缘几近平直。

/species/microtermes-mangzhuangensis/.distribution: 云南勐腊曼庄，海拔六百米。
/species/microtermes-mangzhuangensis/.en: Microtermes manzhuangensis is a small pale species. The soldier head is a long oval, narrow in front and rounded behind, widest at the middle, with a hump on the front of the vertex in profile. The labrum is spear-shaped and widest at its base; the left mandible arches slightly on the inner edge and bears a minute tooth in front of the basal tooth, while the right mandible is slightly narrower. Antennae have 14 segments, the fourth shortest. The pronotum is distinctly notched in front.
/species/microtermes-mangzhuangensis/.soldier: 头部淡黄，上颚赤褐而基部三分之一为黄色，上唇淡黄，触角乳白，前胸背板、腹部与足近乳白。头部密被细短毛，上唇有一对端毛，唇面纵列七至八对长短毛。头作长卵圆形，前段狭、后段圆，中部最宽，后侧宽圆；侧面观头中部前方隆起如丘。上唇矛形，基部最宽。左上颚中段内缘微弓起，基齿前方有一枚微齿；右上颚略细于左上颚。后颏前缘中段略凹，中部最宽。触角十四节，第四节最短，第二节比第四节长一半。前胸背板前缘中央凹入明显，后缘微凹。

/species/microtermes-menglunensis/.distribution: 云南勐腊勐仑，海拔九百米。
/species/microtermes-menglunensis/.en: The soldier of Microtermes menglunensis has a long-oval head widest behind the middle and slightly raised in front of the vertex in profile. The labrum is spear-shaped with a transparent apical rim. Mandibles are stout and straight, slightly narrowed and incurved in front; the left basal tooth is broad and rounded with a minute tooth in front of its notch, and the right basal tooth is smaller with two wavy projections before it. Antennae have 14 segments and the pronotum is saddle-shaped.
/species/microtermes-menglunensis/.soldier: 头部黄色，上颚赤褐而基段三分之一与头同色，上唇黄色微带棕，触角微黄，前胸背板淡黄褐，腹部与足淡黄。头部密生细短毛，上唇有一对端毛，自唇端至中部纵列六对长短毛；前胸背板周缘与背面疏生长短毛。头作长卵圆形，前狭后宽，最宽处在中部偏后；侧面观背中部靠前隆起。上唇矛形，端部唇沿透明。上颚粗直，前端稍细而内弯；左上颚基齿宽圆，凹缘前方有一枚微齿；右上颚基齿略小于左上颚者，其前方有两个波状突起。后颏隆起，前方三分之一处最宽。触角十四节，第四节最短。前胸背板似马鞍状，前半部略翘起，前后缘中央均凹入。

/species/microtermes-mengpengensis/.distribution: 云南勐腊勐棒，海拔五百八十米。
/species/microtermes-mengpengensis/.en: In Microtermes mengpengensis the soldier head is nearly circular to oval, widest at the middle and humped in profile. The labrum is tongue-shaped with a blunt tip, and the mandibles are slender and incurved in front, with a minute or indistinct tooth near the middle of the inner edge. Antennae have 15 segments, the third shortest, or 16 with the fourth shortest. The pronotum is narrower than the head and notched in the middle both in front and behind. Minor soldiers are paler and smaller.
/species/microtermes-mengpengensis/.soldier: 头部淡黄或深黄，上颚赤褐而基部三分之一为黄色，上唇淡黄，触角乳白，前胸背板、腹部与足淡黄至近乳白。头部密被细短毛，并散生长毛；上唇有一对端毛，两侧纵列六对至数根长毛；前胸背板周缘疏生长毛。头近圆形或近卵圆形，中部最宽；侧面观中部或前方隆起如丘。上唇舌形，端部钝圆。上颚前端细而内弯，内缘中段有一枚极小的齿粒，或不明显。后颏隆起，中部宽弧出。触角十五节的个体，第三节最短；十六节者，第四节最短。前胸背板狭于头宽，前后缘中央内凹。小兵蚁体色与头色均浅于大兵蚁，体形较小，各部形态近似大兵蚁。

/species/mirocapritermes-hsuchiafui/.distribution: 云南盈江，海拔八百七十米。
/species/mirocapritermes-hsuchiafui/.en: Mirocapritermes hsuchiafui is a termite recorded from Yingjiang, Yunnan, at 870 m. The original account rests on five soldiers, and the text available here supplies only figures of the soldier head in dorsal and lateral view, without a written description of coloration, mandibular dentition or antennal segmentation. Neither alates nor workers are characterized in the source, so the species can at present be recognized only from its locality and from the proportions of the illustrated soldier head.

/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.alate: 头部覆盖密集短毛并散生少量长刚毛；后唇基没有中线；囟小而窄，作裂缝状。左上颚端齿到第一缘齿的间距，等于第一缘齿到第三缘齿的间距；右上颚端齿到第一缘齿的间距稍大于第一缘齿之间的间距。胫节距式三比二比二，前足上面的端刺已明显退化。
/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.distribution: 云南江城康平，海拔九百二十米。
/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.en: The soldier of Mirocapritermes jiangchengensis is yellow with a white abdomen and a rectangular head whose frontal projection is boldly rounded. The labrum is more than twice as long as wide, deeply notched in front with pointed side corners. The mandibles are asymmetrical: the left twists in its front half and hooks to the right, while the right is sword-like and shorter. Antennae have 14 segments and the pronotum is saddle-shaped with unobstructed curved margins. Alates have a narrow slit-like fontanelle and reduced foreleg spurs.
/species/mirocapritermes-jiangchengensis.soldier: 体黄色，腹部乳白；头部稀疏被短毛，额突之前的毛较多，上唇端部有六至八枚长毛，两枚为一排，后颏前端两侧角各有三枚短毛；前胸背板周缘有少数长毛，中区有数枚短毛；足稀被短毛，胫节有刺，腹部毛被密而短。头长方形，额突弧圆而明显突出；上唇长度超过宽度的两倍，作条形，前缘深凹，前侧角尖出并微向外伸。上颚不对称，左上颚前段扭曲，顶端向右弯成钩状；右上颚刀状，短于左上颚。后颏近长方形，最宽处靠前，腰部不甚明显，前缘最窄。触角十四节，第二、三节约等长并长于第四节。前胸背板马鞍形，前后缘均作弧形，中央不凹入；足端距三比二比二。

/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.en: Soldiers are large, with a brownish yellow head mottled reddish and a dark brown nasus; the pronotum is saddle-shaped with a short vertical front lobe, its anterior margin shallowly notched, and the abdomen is slender with the hind leg reaching past its apex. The head is nearly circular and wider than long, with a deeply emarginate hind margin, 13 antennal segments, mandibles lacking a spine, and a waist-like constriction of the postmentum. Workers vary in size without clear dimorphism and have 13 or 14 antennal segments.
/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.soldier: 兵蚁体大。头部棕黄而杂赤色，鼻部暗棕，触角浅于头色；前胸背板前叶棕黄，后叶稍浅，中、后胸及腹部背板深黄，足黄色。头背与鼻密被细短毛，前胸背板背面无毛而周缘疏列短毛，腹部背板散生小毛。头近圆形，最宽处在中部附近，宽大于长（不计鼻部），后缘中央深凹，触角窝后侧下方不收缩，鼻基与头背相接处略膨大。侧面观头背仅后端微隆，自中部平伸至鼻端，鼻长约当连鼻头长之半而短于头宽。触角十三节，第三节长于第四节，第二节最短。上颚无尖刺，后颏两侧近中部收成腰状，后部宽阔而以近后端处最宽。前胸背板马鞍形，前叶垂直而较短，前缘中央微凹，后缘中部突出而无凹口。腹部细长，后足伸过腹端，胫节距二比二比二，跗节四节。小型个体头近光裸，仅鼻端有少许短毛，头宽圆形，鼻作圆管状而末端略上翘，鼻基两侧各具一小突起，触角十三至十四节，上颚端齿钝而不显。
/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于棘白蚁属 Pilotermes，本站现归入棘象白蚁属 Nasopilotermes。
/species/nasopilotermes-jiangxiensis/.worker: 工蚁个体大小略有差异，未见明显二型。体大者触角十四节，头部黄色，头背 Y 形缝清楚；体小者触角十三节，头部白色而杂浅黄，Y 形缝隐约可见。两类个体左、右上颚端齿的后缘均长于第一缘齿的前缘；左颚第二缘齿与第一缘齿后缘愈合，第三缘齿前、后缘几乎等长；右颚端齿与第一缘齿之间的端距短于第一、二缘齿之间的端距，第一、二缘齿后缘长度近等，第二缘齿后缘较直。胫节距二比二比二，跗节四节。

/species/nasutitermes-bannaensis/.en: The soldier is reddish brown over head, thorax and abdomen, with yellowish brown antennae and pale yellow legs. A few short hairs stand at the tip of the nasus, while the dorsum of head, thorax and abdomen is essentially hairless and the sternites carry longer hairs. The head is nearly circular, about as long as wide, narrowed in front and broadest behind, with the region behind the antennal sockets bulging spherically. Mandibles bear long spines, antennae have 14 segments, and the pronotum is erect in front.
/species/nasutitermes-bannaensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部、胸部和腹部红褐，触角黄褐，足淡黄。象鼻末端生数根短毛；头、胸、腹背面均无明显之毛，腹板上的长短毛则较多。头近圆形，长宽几乎相等，前部窄而后部宽，触角窝后方鼓起如球，后缘宽圆而其中央稍平。侧面观鼻略平直，后头稍高于鼻端；上颚生有较长的尖刺。触角十四节，第三节短小。前胸背板前缘直立翘起，前、后缘均无明显凹刻，后缘微凹。胫节距二比二比二，跗节四节。
/species/nasutitermes-bannaensis/.worker: 工蚁左颚端齿与第一缘齿大小几乎相等，各缘齿之间的切边较为平直；右颚端齿亦几等于第一缘齿，第二缘齿的位置靠近第一缘齿。

/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.book_name: 巴山奇象白蚁 Mironasutitermes bashanensis
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.distribution: 陕西镇坪大巴山北坡浪河口。
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.en: This soldier resembles the large form of its relatives but is slightly paler, with the nasus and the front margin of the pronotum darker than the rest. The front margin of the pronotum is almost without a median depression while the hind margin is shallowly concave. Mandibles are short and their teeth inconspicuous. The host plant recorded for the species is Castanea mollissima, and it is known from the northern slope of the Daba Mountains in southern Shaanxi.
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.soldier: 头部与触角均呈褐色，象鼻以及前胸背板前缘的颜色也较深，腹部各节色泽浅淡。体形与大型兵蚁相似，只是色泽稍浅；前胸背板的前缘中央几乎不见凹陷，后缘中央则微凹入；上颚短小，齿突不明显。
/species/nasutitermes-bashanensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于奇象白蚁属 Mironasutitermes，现归入象白蚁属 Nasutitermes。

/species/nasutitermes-bulbus/.distribution: 西藏墨脱西工湖，海拔一千四百米。
/species/nasutitermes-bulbus/.en: The original account of this species preserves only figure captions and the species heading, so no textual description of the soldier, alate or worker is available to summarise. It belongs to Nasutitermes, the snout-bearing termites, but its diagnostic characters cannot be stated here; the entry rests on the type record alone.

/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.distribution: 云南金平猛喇，海拔四百八十米；景洪，海拔五百米。
/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.en: The soldier has a nearly square head, widest at the antennal sockets, with an arched hind margin and a pale T-shaped stripe on the dorsum; the postclypeus is raised and half as long as wide, and the labrum is broadly rounded in front and narrow behind. Antennae have 15 segments, the second longer than the third. The pronotum is strongly convex, sometimes notched in the middle in front, and the abdomen is swollen and oval.
/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.soldier: 兵蚁头近四方形，以触角着生处最宽，后缘弓形；头背有淡色 T 形条纹。后唇基隆起，长度约为宽度之半；上唇前部宽圆，后部狭。触角十五节，第二节长于第三节。前胸背板隆起甚高，部分个体的前缘中央凹入；腹部膨大，呈卵形。体全长四点四三至四点八六毫米。
/species/nasutitermes-castaneus/.worker: 工蚁头部褐黄，触角、胸部与腹部淡黄乃至白色。头、胸及腹部背面被稀疏细短毛，腹部腹面的毛较多且长。

/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.book_name: 长宁奇象白蚊 Mironasutitermes changningensis
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.en: Soldiers are trimorphic. The large form has a brown head, a dark brown nasus, a dark front lobe on the pronotum, and thirteen or occasionally fourteen antennal segments; seen from the side the back of the head rises markedly behind. The medium form is browner with a flatter head, and the small form is pale with twelve antennal segments and faint mandibular teeth. Workers have fourteen antennal segments and a pale T-shaped suture.
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.soldier: 兵蚁三型。大型头部褐色，象鼻深褐，触角黄褐，前胸背板前叶深褐而后叶稍浅，中、后胸背板及腹部背板黄褐，足淡黄。头部毛甚少，鼻端毛稍多，前胸背板周缘有少许短毛。头近宽圆，最宽处在中部稍后，后缘中央凹入；侧观头背缘后部显著隆起，中部较低；鼻基略隆，鼻端上翘，上颚齿明显。触角多为十三节，偶有十四节；十三节者第二节细而短于第四节，十四节者第二节最短。前胸背板马鞍形，前叶短于后叶，前缘中央有切刻，后缘中央切刻不明显；腹部橄榄形。中型头褐黄，鼻赤褐，前胸背板前叶淡赤褐；头扁圆，近中部最宽，鼻端略翘，上颚齿不显；触角十三节。小型头部浅褐黄，鼻浅赤褐；头宽圆，中部偏后最宽，鼻端略翘而较细，上颚齿缺或不明显；触角十二节。
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书置于奇象白蚁属 Mironasutitermes，现归入象白蚁属 Nasutitermes。
/species/nasutitermes-changningensis/.worker: 工蚁头黄褐，淡色T形缝可见，触角淡黄，胸、腹部背板淡褐，足淡黄。头近圆形，最宽处近触角窝，后唇基隆起，触角十四节；左、右上颚端齿的后缘等于或略长于第一缘齿前缘，右上颚第一缘齿的后缘较短于第二缘齿的后缘。前胸背板马鞍形，前缘中央的凹刻明显，腹部橄榄形。头色较浅者毛序与头形同大型，T形缝不明显，触角十三节。

/species/nasutitermes-choui/.en: The soldier has a brownish yellow head and a reddish brown conical nasus whose base is about twice as wide as its middle; the nasus is about two thirds the head length and projects straight forward, its axis nearly parallel to the ventral margin of the head. The head is circular and widest near the middle, with an almost straight hind margin, 13 to 14 antennal segments, and a long slender spine on each mandible. The pronotum is saddle-shaped and about 2.4 times wider than long.
/species/nasutitermes-choui/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐中带黄，鼻赤褐，触角褐黄；前胸背板前部褐色，中、后胸背板、腹部与足淡黄褐，腹板色泽稍深。头面疏布细短微毛，近鼻部渐密，鼻端之毛长而密；胸、腹部背板毛稀疏，腹部及近腹端背板后缘的毛长短不一。头圆形，最宽处在中部附近，后缘中央近乎平直。鼻作圆锥形，基部宽约为中段宽的两倍，长约当头长的三分之二；侧面观鼻平直前伸，其轴与头底缘近于平行，鼻基峰隐约可辨，后头略向后延伸。上颚端刺细长而尖，右上颚基颚齿板约有七条沟。触角十三至十四节，第三节长于第二节，第四节较短；后颏六角形，前后两侧边微凹。前胸背板马鞍形，宽约为长的二点四倍，前缘中央微凹或近平直，后缘近于平直。后足腿节伸过腹部中点，后胫长约当头长的一点一三倍、头宽的一点二三倍。

/species/nasutitermes-communis/.alate: 有翅成虫头部赤褐，触角与后唇基暗黄；前胸背板及腹部背面褐色，腹部腹面褐黄；翅黑色。全体密被细毛。头为卵圆形，相当宽，头顶平坦。复眼长圆而突出；单眼大，位于复眼前方背侧，单、复眼间距小于单眼的宽径。后唇基隆起，后缘向后方弓出，前缘很直，长度不及宽度之半。囟淡色而细长，位于头顶正中。触角十五节，第二、四节长度几乎相等，第三节短，第五节长于第三节而稍短于第四节。前胸背板前宽后狭，前缘平直，中央缺刻明显或付缺，后缘中央微凹。前翅中脉在肩缝处独立伸出，距肘脉较距径分脉为近，至翅长四分之三之后分为二至三条支脉，伸向翅端偏后部位；肘脉约有十一至十二条分支，靠近翅鳞的七条粗而色深。后翅中脉自径分脉分出，其余脉序同前翅。
/species/nasutitermes-communis/.distribution: 福建建瓯、永安、和溪、南靖，江西，湖南，广东南雄。
/species/nasutitermes-communis/.en: Alates are reddish brown with black wings and a very broad oval head, a flat vertex, large projecting eyes and large ocelli whose distance to the eye is less than their width. The postclypeus is arched and less than half as long as wide, the fontanelle is pale and slender, and antennae have 15 segments. The forewing media arises independently at the shoulder and divides into two or three branches, while the cubitus bears about eleven branches. Workers are yellow with a whitish abdomen.
/species/nasutitermes-communis/.worker: 工蚁头部黄色，腹部近于白色。腹背密生短毛，腹面各节后端排成一列直立的较长之毛。头作卵圆形，头顶平，后唇基甚为隆起，长度略小于宽度之半。触角十四节，第二节的长度等于第三、四节之和，第五节短于第二节。前胸背板前部直立，与后部大小约略相同，前缘中央不下凹，或下凹而分成左右两叶。体长三点八八至五毫米。

/species/nasutitermes-curtinasus/.en: The soldier is yellowish brown with slightly paler antennae and a pale yellowish white thorax, abdomen and legs, while the front margin of the pronotum is brown. The head is almost bare; the tip of the nasus carries four long setae and several short ones, two long setae stand behind the vertex, and four longitudinal rows of hairs run between the abdominal tergites. Neither alate nor worker is described in the source.
/species/nasutitermes-curtinasus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部黄褐，触角色泽稍淡，胸、腹部及足淡黄白，前胸背板前缘褐色。头部近于光裸，象鼻末端生有四枚长毛与数根短毛，头顶后方具二枚长毛，腹部背板之间列有四行纵毛。

/species/nasutitermes-dudgeoni/.en: The soldier has a yellowish brown head and a pale yellowish brown nasus with a few small hairs at its tip.
