/species/stylotermes-chongqingensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐色带红，光泽丰富，上唇黄褐，触角与头同色，前胸背板亦为黄褐。头部毛被稀疏，前胸背板中区刚毛约三十根。头壳近长方形，前方稍狭，既宽且厚，囟比较突起。触角十三至十四节，第一节与第三节接近相等，第三节约为第二节两倍。眼圆形而不鼓出。上唇半圆形。上颚军刀状，粗壮，末端稍弯，外缘平滑。下颚内颚叶缘毛约十根。前胸背板似肾形，前缘宽V形凹入，两侧缘急斜向后，后缘中央浅凹，中纵线清楚。后足长为腿宽两点五倍。

/species/stylotermes-choui/.alate: 有翅成虫体深褐色，翅膜灰白色。头壳接近圆形，头盖缝隐约可见，囟前有V形凸纹。复眼长径约为它到头下缘间距的三至四倍。单眼长径约为单复眼间距的二至三倍，单眼与触角窝的距离约为复眼与触角窝距离的两倍。触角十七节。下颚内颚叶缘毛十一根。前后翅的Cu脉约有十六个分支。
/species/stylotermes-choui/.en: Soldiers are reddish brown on the head, brown on the pronotum and pale brownish yellow on the abdomen. The head is rectangular with a rather prominent fontanelle and a semicircular labrum. Mandibular tips are curved and slightly upturned, and eleven marginal setae line the lacinial lobe. Antennae have thirteen or fourteen segments, the third about three times the second. Alates are dark brown with greyish white wings, a nearly circular head and seventeen antennal segments.
/species/stylotermes-choui/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐色带红，前胸背板褐色，腹部淡褐黄，头壳被毛较丰富。头壳长方形，囟比较突起，复眼稍稍鼓起，上唇半圆形。上颚末端较弯并略微翘起。下颚内颚叶缘毛十一根。触角十三至十四节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节的三倍。前胸背板前缘作宽V形缺切，两侧缘缓缓向后斜，后缘中间微凹，中纵线可见，中凹率百分之十二至十九，中区毛较丰富。

/species/stylotermes-crinis/.en: The soldier head is reddish yellow, darker toward the front, with nearly black mandibles. Long bristles are numerous on the front and middle of the head and dense on the labrum. The capsule is rectangular with broad undulate sides and broadly rounded hind angles. The fontanelle is a small sunken dot. Antennae have thirteen segments, the second smallest and the third thick. The pronotum is kidney shaped and flattened, broadly V shaped in front, and the legs are stout.
/species/stylotermes-crinis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部赤黄色，前端略深，上颚近黑色，前胸背板淡黄褐而前缘略深。头壳作长方形，两侧缘似宽波状，后缘几乎平直，后侧角宽圆，头中点之后略收狭。囟细小，呈凹入的点状，侧观囟区平或微隆。眼点不明显。后颏细长，最宽处在近前端五分之一，颏前两侧波形凹入，侧观略弓出于头下缘。触角十三节，第二节最短小，第三节粗长。触角窝盖呈半月形并略上翘。上唇半圆形，前缘弧形外凸。上颚作军刀形，端部内弯，外缘基部略呈波状，内缘中点后方有一枚钝圆小齿。头中部与前部多长刚毛；前胸背板扁平而作肾形，前缘宽V形，前侧角圆，后缘微后凸，中央略有缺刻，中纵线极不明显，面上还有长毛与短茸毛。腿节粗大，胫节细长。

/species/stylotermes-curvatus/.en: Soldiers are dark brown on the head with blackish brown mandibles and a yellowish brown pronotum darker along its margins. The capsule is rectangular and the fontanelle pore obvious though hardly raised. Antennae have fourteen segments, the third twice the second, and the antennal covers reach almost to the lateral margins. Eyes are yellowish brown. Mandibles are long with strongly curved tips, the left inner edge minutely serrate, and about ten long setae stand on the pronotal disc.
/species/stylotermes-curvatus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部深褐色，上颚黑褐色，上唇淡褐色，前胸背板黄褐色而周缘较深，足的腿节淡黄褐，胫节与跗节黄褐。前胸背板中区有长毛十余根。头壳长方形，囟孔明显但几乎没有突起。触角十四节，第三节长度约为第二节的两倍；触角窝盖片强烈几丁化，几乎盖及头两侧缘。复眼黄褐色，与触角窝相距较近。上唇亚圆形。上颚长，末端弯曲很厉害，外缘稍有凹缢，左上颚内缘具极细的锯齿痕迹。前胸背板前缘作宽V形，中央呈U形凹入，两侧缘缓缓向后斜，后缘凹入不明显。

/species/stylotermes-fontanellus/.en: Soldiers are brownish yellow on the head, darker in front, with a yellow labrum and nearly black mandibles reddish brown at the base. The capsule is rectangular with nearly parallel sides and broad rounded hind angles, flattened in profile. The fontanelle is a small elongate dot. Eye spots are large, oval and flat. The labrum is nearly circular with twelve long hairs along the front edge. Antennae have fourteen segments, the third longest and club shaped.
/species/stylotermes-fontanellus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐黄色，前端稍深，上唇中央黄，上颚近黑而基部赤褐，触角褐黄、端节近黄，前胸背板周缘棕黄，腹部黄。头壳长方形，两侧近平行，后缘狭而平直，后侧角宽弧状；侧观头形扁平。囟细小，呈长圆点状，囟区几乎不隆起。眼点卵圆形且较大，并不鼓出。触角窝盖呈弓形，向上翘。上唇近似圆形，前缘生十二枚长毛。上颚军刀状，端部弯曲较剧。后颏前部扩大，腰部狭长，腰缩指数约零点四四。触角十四节，第二节最短，第三节最长大，约为第二节两点五倍，形如锤状。前胸背板肾形，较宽大，前缘略上翘，V形凹口宽而较深，前侧角狭圆并稍前伸，后缘宽弧形，后侧角宽弧形，中纵线几乎不见。后足腿节十分粗大。

/species/stylotermes-guiyangensis/.biology: 标本采自洋槐、白杨与中华柳。
/species/stylotermes-guiyangensis/.en: The soldier head is deep yellowish brown with purple brown mandibles whose bases are dark reddish brown. Setae are numerous on the capsule and pronotum, about thirty long ones on the pronotal disc. The head is rectangular with an obvious but unraised fontanelle pore. The labrum is a flattened square. Mandibular tips are rather curved, and antennae have fourteen segments, the third strongly sclerotized and twice the second. The pronotum is V notched in the middle of its fore margin.
/species/stylotermes-guiyangensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部深黄褐色，上颚紫褐而颚基深褐带红，上唇与前胸背板黄褐，足淡黄而胫节较深。头壳与前胸背板上的刚毛较多，前胸背板中区长毛约三十根。头壳长方形，囟孔明显但没有突起。上唇似扁方形，唇端前侧圆出而中央平直。颚端较弯。触角十四节，第三节强烈几丁化，明显粗于第二节，长度约为第二节两倍。触角窝盖片强烈几丁化，未盖及头侧缘。复眼淡黄，其与触角窝的间距大致等于短径。前胸背板前缘中央V形切入，两侧缘急斜向后收，后缘接近平直而中央几乎不凹，中线可见。

/species/stylotermes-hanyuanicus/.en: The available account gives no morphological description for this species; only the name, a locality in Sichuan and the host plant are recorded, together with figure references not reproduced here. No soldier or alate characters are therefore asserted. The entry is retained to document the name and its recorded occurrence within Stylotermes, and the morphological fields are deliberately left empty rather than supplied from other species.

/species/stylotermes-inclinatus/.en: The soldier head is chestnut brown with purple brown mandibles and a yellowish brown thorax and abdomen, the capsule sparsely hairy. It is rectangular with parallel sides, a straight hind margin and a frontal slope of about twenty three degrees. The fontanelle is a small flat pore and the labrum semicircular. Mandibles are strong with slender shafts and a long, moderately swollen basal peak. The pronotum is kidney shaped with about six setae on its disc.
/species/stylotermes-inclinatus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部栗褐色，上颚紫褐色，胸部与腹部黄褐色，头壳的毛较稀。头壳长方形，两侧平行，头后缘中央平直，额坡约成二十三度。囟小，呈孔状且平坦，距额缘零点六二毫米。上唇半圆形。上颚颇为强壮，颚体较细直，末端稍弯，颚基峰较长且适度膨出。触角已断，触角窝盖片稍大。后颏腰区狭长。前胸背板肾形，前缘作宽V形凹入，两侧缘与后缘连成半圆形，中凹率百分之九，中区毛约六根。

/species/stylotermes-jinyunicus/.alate: 有翅成虫头壳近似圆形，头盖缝与囟都不清楚，囟前有数条川形纵纹。触角十三至十五节（标本已断）。复眼长径约为它到头下缘间距的三倍。单眼长径约为单复眼间距的三倍，单眼与触角窝的距离约为复眼与触角窝距离的两倍。下颚内颚叶缘毛十一根。
/species/stylotermes-jinyunicus/.en: Soldiers are yellowish brown on the head, with a slightly paler pronotum and a pale yellow abdomen; no further soldier characters are recorded. Alates have a nearly circular head capsule in which the coronal suture and the fontanelle are indistinct, several short longitudinal striae lying before the fontanelle. Antennae comprise thirteen to fifteen segments, though the specimens are broken. The eye is about three times as long as its distance to the lower margin of the head.
/species/stylotermes-jinyunicus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部黄褐色，前胸背板色泽稍浅，腹部淡黄色。

/species/stylotermes-labralis/.en: Soldiers are reddish brown on the head, with a slightly paler pronotum and a pale brownish yellow abdomen. The head capsule is rectangular and the fontanelle slightly raised. The labrum is nearly circular, a little longer than wide, and the mandibles are rather curved. Twelve marginal setae line the lacinial lobe. Antennae have fourteen or fifteen segments, the third about three times the second. The compound eyes bulge, and the pronotum is V notched in front.
/species/stylotermes-labralis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐色带红，前胸背板较淡，腹部淡褐黄。头壳长方形，囟稍突起。触角十四至十五节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节三倍。复眼鼓起。上唇近似圆形，长度略大于宽度；下颚内颚叶缘毛十二根；上颚弯曲较明显。前胸背板前缘V形凹入，中央呈U形切入，后缘中央浅凹，中线可见。

/species/stylotermes-laticrus/.en: The soldier head is reddish chestnut brown, the pronotum chestnut brown and the abdomen pale chestnut. The capsule is rectangular and the fontanelle flat. Antennae have thirteen or fourteen segments, the first slightly larger than the third and the third about three times the second. The compound eyes protrude and the labrum is semicircular. Mandibular tips are curved and slightly upturned, the left mandible about two thirds of the head length, and the pronotum is broadly V notched in front.
/species/stylotermes-laticrus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部栗褐色带红，前胸背板栗褐色，腹部淡栗褐色。头壳长方形，囟平坦，几乎没有突起。触角十三至十四节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节的三倍。复眼鼓出。上唇半圆形。上颚末端较弯并稍稍翘起；左上颚约为头壳长的零点六七倍、头最宽的零点一零五倍；下颚内颚叶缘毛十一根。前胸背板前缘作宽V形凹入，中央呈U形切入，后缘中央浅凹，中线隐约可见。

/species/stylotermes-latilabrum/.en: The soldier head is brownish yellow with chestnut brown mandibles and a yellowish brown pronotum, moderately hairy. The capsule is rectangular, its sides nearly parallel or slightly narrowed behind, the dorsal edge rather flat. The fontanelle is a small raised mound. The labrum is ligulate, short and broad. Mandibles are straight with slender, slightly curved tips. Antennae have twelve or thirteen segments, the second very short and the third swollen. The pronotum is butterfly shaped with a broad V notch.
/species/stylotermes-latilabrum/.soldier: 兵蚁头部褐黄色，上颚赤褐色，前胸背板黄褐色，头壳被毛适度。头壳长方形，两侧接近平行或稍向后狭，头背缘颇平，额坡约四十五度。囟小，呈点状，距额前缘零点六二毫米，作小丘状隆起。上唇舌状，短而宽。上颚较直，末端细而稍弯，颚基峰可见。触角十二至十三节，第二节很短，第三节膨大，为第二节的两倍以上。触角窝上缘扩展成盖，几乎盖及头侧。眼点可见。后颏腰区细长，腰缩指数零点三三。前胸背板蝶翅形，前缘宽，中央V形宽凹入，两侧缘向后与后缘连成弧状，后缘中央无缺刻，中区毛细。

/species/stylotermes-latipedunculus/.en: The soldier head is chestnut brown with blackish brown mandibles and a pronotum slightly paler than the head. It is rectangular with parallel sides and a straight hind margin. The fontanelle is a small flat pore and the labrum semicircular. Mandibles are stout with nearly straight tips and a visible basal peak. Antennae are broken, and the antennal covers are large but do not span the sides of the head. The pronotum is kidney shaped with two long setae on the disc.
/species/stylotermes-latipedunculus/.soldier: 兵蚁头部栗褐色，上颚黑褐色，前胸背板色较头稍淡，头壳毛稀。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘中央平直。囟小，呈平坦的孔状，距额缘零点七三毫米。上唇半圆形。触角已断，触角窝盖片较大而未盖满头两侧。后颏宽区中央似有点突，腰区宽长。上颚粗壮，末端稍直，颚基峰可见。前胸背板肾形，前缘宽V形凹入，两侧缘与后缘连成半圆形，后缘中央凹入不明显，中区长毛两根，间杂少数短毛。

/species/stylotermes-lianpingensis/.en: Soldiers are dark reddish brown on the head, with a paler pronotum and a pale yellow abdomen; the capsule is rather sparsely hairy and about twenty setae occupy the pronotal disc. The head is nearly rectangular, slightly narrowed in front, with a faintly raised fontanelle. The labrum is semicircular. Mandibles are slightly curved; the left inner edge bears a small tooth below the middle and the right one near its posterior third.
/species/stylotermes-lianpingensis/.soldier: 兵蚁头部深褐色带红，前胸背板较淡，腹部淡黄色，头壳被毛较疏，前胸背板中区毛约二十根。头壳近长方形，两侧在前方稍狭，囟稍突起，复眼稍鼓，上唇半圆形。上颚末端稍弯；左上颚内缘光滑，近中部下方有一小齿，右上颚近后方三分之一处也有一小齿，颚基峰不明显。下颚内颚叶缘毛约十根。触角十四至十五节，第一节大于第三节。前胸背板前缘呈宽V形凹口，后缘中央浅凹入，中纵线清楚。

/species/stylotermes-longignathus/.en: Soldier: head yellow, elongate and roughly rectangular, the sides nearly parallel. Labrum semicircular with long marginal setae. Mandibles long and sabre-shaped, only weakly curved, each inner margin bearing a small triangular tooth and a basal notch. Antennae with the third segment slender, the fourth short. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior margin shallowly incised. Alate: body brown, wings with the median vein unbranched and the cubitus divided into many branches. The species is recorded from southern China, where colonies inhabit dead wood and old stumps; details of the biology remain poorly known.
/species/stylotermes-longignathus/.soldier: 头部呈红棕色，头的前缘连同触角窝盖片为赤褐色，上唇棕黄，上颚几近黑色。触角本身淡黄，自第三节起，各节后半段转为淡棕至褐色，节与节之间因而界线分明。前胸背板淡赤棕色，腿节淡黄，胫节与跗节淡黄棕，腹部淡黄白。头部被毛稍多，囟区四周生有数根长刚毛，唇基毛稀疏，上唇前缘共十二根毛，前胸背板背面也被毛稍多。

/species/stylotermes-mecocephalus/.distribution: 广西靖西（海拔五百五十米）。
/species/stylotermes-mecocephalus/.en: Soldier: head yellow with a brown frontal area, the head capsule rectangular and distinctly elongate, sides parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle a minute pit about 0.03 mm across, slightly raised. Labrum semicircular, its margin translucent and bearing long setae. Mandibles with a wide curved outer edge, each inner margin carrying a small triangular tooth near mid-length and a large basal process. Antennae twelve to fourteen segmented. Pronotum with a shallow anterior incision and strongly concave posterior margin. The species lives in damp dead wood in southern China.
/species/stylotermes-mecocephalus/.soldier: 头黄色，额区呈褐，上颚前半黑褐，上唇淡黄；触角窝盖片与触角基部数节褐色，愈向端部愈淡，体躯除前胸背板边缘较深外多为淡黄白色。头壳长方形而狭长，两侧缘平行，后缘宽圆。囟孔很小，孔径约零点零三毫米。上唇半圆形，唇端圆钝，唇缘半透明，生有长刚毛。上颚外缘弯成宽阔弧线，颚端微微内弯；左右两颚内缘的中下部各具一枚三角形小齿，右颚者稍近颚基；左颚基部有一大型突起，其前凹刻近似直角，右颚基部则为一圆形突起。触角十二至十四节，第一节与第三节等长或稍长之；触角窝盖片甚大，可将头侧缘完全遮住。后颏宽部中央带点状刻纹，侧观露出于头下缘之外。前胸背板前缘凹入浅，后缘凹陷显著，两侧缘斜向后收，腿节膨大。

/species/stylotermes-mirabilis/.en: Soldier: head yellow, the capsule elongate; fontanelle a small circular pit; labrum short and setose. Mandibles stout and sabre-like, the left one bearing a triangular tooth at mid-length, the right with a corresponding small tooth. Antennae fourteen segmented, the third segment shorter than the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped with a shallow median incision. Alate: body brown, eyes oval and prominent, ocelli close to the compound eyes; wings with the median vein arising from the shoulder suture. Recorded from southern China in dead wood; the biology is little known.
/species/stylotermes-mirabilis/.soldier: 头褐黄，前胸背板暗黄。头部生短毛，以前部略密。头壳长方形，两侧缘平行，后缘宽圆。囟呈小圆点状，略微隆起。上唇为宽舌形，最宽处在中点之前，宽度大于长度。上颚粗壮而直，颚端稍弯，颚基的峰状隆起不显。触角十四节。后颏的腰区狭长，后颏长度约为其宽度的二点八至二点九倍，约为腰区最狭处的七点四七至七点五八倍。前胸背板肾形，宽度约为中长的两倍，前缘以宽V形深凹，两侧缘与后缘连成宽阔的弧形，后缘中央微凹，中区生毛约十根。

/species/stylotermes-orthognathus/.en: The soldier's head is reddish brown, the mandibles blackish brown, the labrum yellowish brown, and the pronotum yellowish brown with a darker rim; the legs are pale yellowish brown, deeper on tibiae and tarsi. About twenty long setae stand on the middle of the pronotum. The capsule is rectangular with a distinct but barely raised fontanelle, and antennae have 14 segments, the heavily sclerotized third longer than the second. The left mandible, short and straight-tipped, equals the greatest head width and measures 0.55 to 0.61 of the capsule length.
/species/stylotermes-orthognathus/.soldier: 头呈带红的褐色，上颚黑褐，上唇黄褐，前胸背板黄褐而边缘较深，足淡黄褐，胫节与跗节颜色更深。前胸背板中区约有二十根长毛。头壳为长方形，囟孔清楚，但几乎不高出表面。触角十四节，第三节几丁化程度强，长度大于第二节；触角窝盖片同样高度几丁化，与头两侧缘之间留有较远距离。复眼淡黄，它与触角窝的间距约等于复眼的短径。上唇近圆形，唇端略平。上颚短，端部直伸，左上颚的长度约与头的最宽处相当，相当于头壳长度的零点五五至零点六一倍。前胸背板前缘以宽V形浅凹，两侧缘急促地向后倾斜，后缘中央几乎不凹，中纵线可以看见。

/species/stylotermes-planifrons/.distribution: 重庆缙云山（海拔七百五十米）。
/species/stylotermes-planifrons/.en: Soldiers are yellowish brown tinged with red, with a yellowish brown labrum, blackish brown mandibles, and brownish red socket flaps and first three antennal segments that fade toward the tip. The capsule looks rectangular, slightly constricted at midlength and a little widened behind, with broad rounded hind corners. The fontanelle is flat, the labrum semicircular, and the sabre-like mandibles curve inward. The left mandible is about 0.65 of the head length and 1.10 of the greatest head width; antennae have 12 segments.
/species/stylotermes-planifrons/.soldier: 头为带红的黄褐色，上唇黄褐，上颚黑褐；触角窝盖片及触角第一至第三节褐红，向端部逐节变淡；前胸背板黄褐，腹部淡黄。头壳被毛稀疏，前胸背板中区的刚毛约十根。头壳略似长方形，两侧在中部稍有收缩，往后又略微放宽，后侧角宽而圆。囟平坦，几乎不隆起。上唇半圆形。上颚作军刀状，颚端向内侧弯，外缘为宽阔的弧形。左上颚长度约为头壳长度的零点六五倍，约当头最宽处的一点一零倍。下颚内颚叶的缘毛约八根。触角十二节，第一节与第三节几乎等长，第三节约为第二节的二点五倍。前胸背板前缘中央凹成宽U形，后缘中央近平直，中纵线隐约可辨。

/species/stylotermes-robustus/.en: Soldier: head yellow brown and stout, the capsule almost rectangular with parallel sides. Fontanelle a distinct circular pit. Labrum semicircular, the front margin setose. Mandibles very robust, short and strongly curved, the inner margins armed with a large basal tooth and a smaller median one. Antennae twelve to thirteen segmented. Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long, the anterior margin with a shallow notch and the posterior margin nearly straight. Alate: body dark brown; wings with the median vein unbranched. Recorded from southern China in dead wood, where colonies are small.
/species/stylotermes-robustus/.soldier: 头壳栗褐而带红，前胸背板栗褐，腹部淡褐黄。头壳呈长方形，光泽较强。囟平坦，几乎不突起。触角十五至十六节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节的两倍。上唇接近方形。上颚端部略弯，下颚内颚叶缘毛九根。前胸背板前缘以宽V形凹入，中央又作U形切入，后缘中央接近平直，中凹率百分之二十一至百分之二十四，中线隐约可见。

/species/stylotermes-setosus/.en: Soldier: head yellow brown, darker anteriorly; mandibles blackish brown; body pale yellow. Head, thorax, abdomen, antennae and legs all clothed with rather coarse erect setae, a diagnostic feature of the species. Head capsule rectangular, sides nearly parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle a small dot on the frons, raised in profile. Labrum oval, its front end blunt and projecting, about as long as wide. Mandibles stout, slightly curved, each inner margin with a minute tooth. Antennae thirteen to fourteen segmented. Pronotum reniform, deeply incised in front.
/species/stylotermes-setosus/.soldier: 头部褐黄，前端色泽较深，上颚黑褐，上唇深黄，复眼所在的小点淡黄，触角褐黄而第三节较深。前胸背板褐黄，中胸、后胸、足与腹部淡黄，腹板淡白。头、胸、腹背面及触角、足均生较粗的直立刚毛。头壳长方形，两侧略平行，后缘宽圆。囟在前额中央，形如小圆点，侧观明显隆起。上唇卵圆形，边缘微透明，两侧稍平行，前端钝圆并向前突出，长与宽几乎相等。上颚粗壮，顶端略尖而微弯，两颚内缘的中下部各有一枚微小齿突。触角十三至十四节，第三节最粗最长，呈倒圆锥形，第二节与第四节几乎等长。眼圆形，位于头前触角基侧，并不突出。前胸背板肾形，前缘宽而深凹，前部较宽，前侧角浑圆，两侧缘斜向后收，后缘中部微凹。

/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.alate: 头壳褐色，触角、胸部、腹部与足淡褐。头壳近圆形而略长。囟小，其前方有纵纹。额的前部有浅凹纹。侧面观头顶较平，后唇基微微隆起，位置低于单眼。触角十七节。复眼长圆形，突出率约百分之十五；复眼与头下缘之间的距离约为复眼长径的五分之一，单眼与复眼的间距约为单眼长径的二分之一。前胸背板宽度约为其中长的一点七五倍，前缘以宽V形浅凹，两侧缘宽圆，后缘接近平直，中央稍凹。前翅长于后翅，前翅长七点四至七点九毫米、宽二点一零至二点一五毫米，后翅长七点一至七点四毫米、宽一点九至二点零毫米；前翅鳞大于后翅鳞，后翅鳞基部略为前翅鳞所覆盖；肘脉呈梳状，约有十余条分支。
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.biology: 寄主记录有枫香、对叶榕、麻栎与木油桐。
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.en: The soldier has a reddish brown head, purplish brown mandibles, an orange-brown pronotum and moderately hairy capsule. Alates have a brown capsule, slightly longer than round, with a small fontanelle preceded by longitudinal striae. Antennae have 17 segments; the eyes are elongate-oval and protrude about 15 percent, lying one-fifth of an eye length above the lower head margin. The pronotum is about 1.75 times as wide as long, widely and shallowly V-notched in front. Forewings exceed hindwings, and the cubitus is comb-like with about ten branches.
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.soldier: 头赤褐色，上颚紫褐色，前胸背板橙褐色，头壳被毛适度。
/species/stylotermes-sinensis/.taxonomy_note: 原书属名印作 Srylotermes，系 Stylotermes 之拼写讹误，现用属名与此一致。

/species/stylotermes-sui/.en: Soldier: head yellow, the capsule somewhat elongate with nearly straight sides. Fontanelle a small circular pit on the frons, visible in profile. Labrum rounded, with several long marginal setae. Mandibles sabre-shaped, stout, the left bearing a triangular tooth at about mid-length. Antennae thirteen segmented, the third segment shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin weakly emarginate. Alate: body brown, the compound eyes oval. The species is recorded from southern China, where it occurs in dead wood and rotten logs; its biology is otherwise unknown.
/species/stylotermes-sui/.soldier: 头棕褐，额区色更深，上颚黑褐，前胸背板淡黄褐，腹部与足白中带黄。头壳被毛适中。头壳长方形，两侧接近平行，后缘宽圆。囟孔向头顶突出，形似火山口。上唇前半为半圆形，唇端平直，唇缘的毛长而较多。上颚军刀状，粗壮，颚端稍弯。左上颚内缘中点下方留有一枚小齿的痕迹，右上颚内缘对应处有二枚小齿痕，两颚基部均具大形齿突与凹口。触角十一至十二节，基节与第三节长度相近，第二节最短；触角窝盖片不能遮及头两侧缘。前胸背板宽度为长度的一点九至二点零倍，前缘宽凹，中央呈U形，中线可见，后缘半圆形，中区的长毛约二十根。

/species/stylotermes-triplanus/.en: Soldier: head pale brownish yellow, the capsule rectangular and rather flat. Fontanelle a small pit on the frons. Labrum semicircular with long setae along the margin. Mandibles slender and sabre-like, the left one with a small tooth before the middle and the right with a corresponding tooth. Antennae fourteen segmented, the third segment equal to the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped, flat, the anterior margin with a shallow median notch. Alate: body brown; wings with the median and cubitus veins as described for the genus. Recorded from southern China in dead wood.
/species/stylotermes-triplanus/.soldier: 头带红的褐色，前胸背板褐色，腹部淡黄褐。头壳长方形，囟孔大，但隆起不高。上唇前缘平直。上颚较细而直，下颚内颚叶的缘毛九根。触角十三至十五节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节为第二节的两倍。前胸背板前缘近乎平直，中央有一浅的切入，后缘中部微凹，两侧缘急促向后倾斜，中线隐约可辨。

/species/stylotermes-tsaii/.alate: 头深黄褐；触角黄棕；前唇基近白，后唇基与上唇棕黄；前胸背板黄褐，足棕黄；翅膜透明而翅脉黑褐；腹背板深褐黄。头部被稀疏短毛并杂少许长毛。头背面观近圆形，半月形触角斑明显。复眼近圆形，突出于头侧缘；单眼长卵形，稍突起，紧邻复眼而不接触，其间距约为单眼短径之半。上唇半圆形，宽稍大于长；后唇基为狭横条；后颏腰鼓状，长大于宽，两侧缘弧状突出。触角十七节，第二、三节较小，第四节以上渐次增大，第八节以上呈纺锤形。左上颚三枚缘齿，第一缘齿小于第三而大于第二；右上颚二枚相邻缘齿。前胸背板窄于头宽连眼，前缘中部缺刻稍明显。前翅稍长于后翅，中脉自肩缝发出，不分支，与径分脉相接而偏近肘脉；肘脉约十六个分支。
/species/stylotermes-tsaii/.distribution: 四川阆中（海拔四百八十米）。
/species/stylotermes-tsaii/.en: Soldier: head dark yellow brown, the capsule elongate and parallel-sided. Fontanelle a small circular pit. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, with long setae. Mandibles stout and sabre-like, the left with a triangular tooth at mid-length. Antennae fourteen segmented. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior margin with a shallow incision. Alate: head dark yellow brown, compound eyes large and protruding, ocelli oval and close to the eyes; wings with the median vein arising from the shoulder suture and the cubitus dividing into about sixteen branches. Recorded from southern China in dead wood.

/species/stylotermes-undulatus/.en: Soldiers are yellow with a brown frons, blackish brown mandibular tips, a pale yellow labrum and a white front clypeus. The antennal-socket flaps and the first three antennal segments are brown, fading segment by segment toward the tip. Except for the darker rim of the pronotum, the remainder of the body is pale yellowish white in varying degrees, the abdomen being the palest.
/species/stylotermes-undulatus/.soldier: 头部呈黄色，额区作褐色，上颚前端黑褐，上唇淡黄，前唇基白色；触角窝盖片与触角第一至第三节褐色，向端部逐节转淡。除前胸背板周缘颜色较深外，身体其余部分均呈深浅不一的淡黄白色，腹部尤为浅淡。

/species/stylotermes-valvules/.distribution: 广西金秀（海拔八百米）、广东、福建、江西。
/species/stylotermes-valvules/.en: Soldier: fontanelle about 0.06 mm across, mound-like and projecting above the frontal surface. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, translucent at the margin and bearing long setae. Mandibles stout, sabre-shaped, only slightly curved; the left inner margin carries a triangular tooth at mid-length and the right a corresponding tooth nearer the base. Antennae twelve to fourteen segmented, the third segment elongate. Eyes degenerate, faintly visible behind the antennal sockets. Postmentum club-shaped. Pronotum reniform, its anterior margin raised, the posterior margin shallowly concave.
/species/stylotermes-valvules/.soldier: 囟孔直径约零点零六毫米，从侧面看像一座小丘，高出额顶面。上唇半圆形，宽大于长，唇缘半透明，生有十余根长刚毛。两颚呈军刀形，相当粗壮，末端略微弯曲。左颚内缘的中下部生一粒三角形小齿，右颚对应处、略近基部亦有同样的小齿粒。触角十二至十四节，第三节较长，呈倒圆锥形；触角窝盖片较短，不能覆盖头两侧缘。复眼退化，在触角窝后方隐约可辨。后颏棍棒状，前宽后狭，前缘微微凸起，从侧面看其中段隐没于向外弓出的头下缘之内。前胸背板近似肾形，前缘稍稍翘起，中凹的凹角约一百五十度，后缘凹入较浅，两侧缘向后强烈收缩。腿节粗壮膨大，胫节细长。

/species/stylotermes-wuyinicus/.alate: 身体深褐，翅膜淡灰白。头壳近圆形，头盖缝隐约可辨。囟色淡而下凹，其前方有数条川字形纵纹。复眼长径约为其至头下缘间距的四至五倍，单眼长径约为单眼与复眼间距的四倍。单眼至触角窝的距离约为复眼至触角窝距离的三倍。下颚内颚叶的缘毛九根。前后翅肘脉约有十七个分支。
/species/stylotermes-wuyinicus/.en: The soldier's head is deep yellowish brown, the pronotum slightly paler and the abdomen pale yellow. The capsule is nearly rectangular, widening a little behind, with a slightly raised fontanelle, a semicircular labrum and sabre-like mandibles. Antennae are broken in the material, but the first segment exceeds the third, which is about twice the second. The pronotum is widely V-notched in front with about twenty hairs in the middle. Alates are dark brown with pale grey wings, a nearly round head and a shallow, pale fontanelle preceded by several striae.
/species/stylotermes-wuyinicus/.soldier: 头深黄褐，前胸背板色稍淡，腹部淡黄。头壳近长方形，两侧往后方略微扩出。囟稍有突起。上唇半圆形。上颚军刀状，颚端微弯。下颚内颚叶的缘毛九根。触角均已折断，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节的两倍。前胸背板前缘有宽V形缺切，两侧缘急促向后斜，后缘中央微凹，中纵线可见，中区毛约二十根。

/species/stylotermes-xichangensis/.distribution: 四川西昌邛海（海拔一千五百米）。
/species/stylotermes-xichangensis/.en: The account of this species in the present volume is fragmentary. The soldier and alate sections are occupied by the family description of the Termitidae and the generic diagnosis of Microcerotermes, together with a key to the genera, and only the figure caption and the type locality survive. The species is recorded from Qionghai, Xichang, Sichuan, at an elevation of about 1500 m. No morphological description of the soldier or the winged adult can therefore be given here, and the biology remains unknown.

/species/termes-marjoriae/.alate: 头深棕黄，触角、后唇基、胸部、腹部与翅比头色浅，腹部腹面最淡。全身密被毛，翅面缺毛。头宽卵形；复眼颇大，单眼小而作长圆形，距复眼很近；囟位于头顶中央，作纵条形凹斑；后唇基隆起甚高，前缘直，后缘半圆，长度约为宽度之半。触角十五节，第二、三节约等长，或第二节长于第三节，第二与第四节近相等。前胸背板前侧角向前突，后侧角大圆，前缘浅凹，后缘中央内凹。前翅径分脉紧靠前缘伸达翅尖，中脉在肩缝处独立伸出，与肘脉的距离近于与径分脉者，伸达翅尖而略有分支，肘脉约有十二个分支；后翅中脉由径分脉基部分出，其余翅脉同前翅。
/species/termes-marjoriae/.distribution: 云南景洪，海拔五百米；国外见于缅甸。
/species/termes-marjoriae/.en: Soldiers of Termes marjoriae have a long, tubular head with a truncate front and a large, forward-then-upward frontal projection. The mandibles are symmetrical, slender and pincer-like, each with a small blunt tooth at about one eighth from the rear of the inner edge, and the left bears a large rounded tooth behind it. The labrum is rectangular with needle-like front corners. Alates are dark yellowish brown with a broad oval head, large eyes, a longitudinal fontanellar groove and 15 antennal segments.
/species/termes-marjoriae/.soldier: 头似长方形筒状，两侧缘略直，后侧角略圆，后缘微向后弯，前端作截断状。额部突起十分显著，基部粗宽，顶端尖圆并朝向前上方；侧面观此突起先向前伸，随后转向上方。上颚对称，细长如钳，前端细扁，呈钩状弯向中线；侧面观上颚先向前上方伸出，再向下弯，形如弯棍。两上颚内缘后段的八分之一处各有一枚小齿，齿尖钝；左上颚小齿之后有一个大齿状突，顶端圆钝。上唇近长方形，两前侧角伸长成针状。触角十四节，第二、三节等长，第四节最短或与第二节等长。

/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.alate: 有翅成虫全身暗色。头呈宽卵形，后唇基色淡，宽度为长度的数倍；囟小，多呈长形并分叉；触角各节不很长；中、后胸背板后缘凹入颇宽；前翅鳞与后翅鳞大小相仿；径脉缺，中脉与肘脉相距甚近。
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.book_name: 鄞县夏氏白蚁 Xiaitermes yinxianensis
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.en: Soldiers occur in two sizes. Small individuals have a yellowish brown head, a reddish brown nasus with visible frontal gland ducts, a broad pear-shaped head, 13 antennal segments, and a saddle-shaped pronotum with a raised front lobe. Large individuals have a round or long-oval head with a tubular nasus, very small mandibles whose anterolateral corner is blunt or bears a spine, and short antennal segments. Alates are uniformly dark, with a broad oval head, a wide pale postclypeus, a small forked fontanelle, and the radial vein absent.
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.soldier: 小型个体头黄褐色，象鼻赤褐，额腺管可见，触角近于头色，前胸背板淡黄褐而前部淡赤褐，中、后胸背板与足黄色，毛序与大型个体相同。头略作宽梨形，最宽处位于中后部；象鼻作圆管状，侧面观稍斜向上翘，头顶略隆，鼻基两侧各具一小突起；上颚端齿明显；触角十三节，第三节长于第二、四节，第二、四节约等长。前胸背板马鞍形，前部翘起，前、后缘中央的凹切均不明显。胫节距二比二比二，跗节四节。大型个体头为圆形或长卵形，象鼻自额前伸出，作管状或前细后粗的圆锥形；头中部不狭缩，头顶与鼻的交接处平直或微凹，触角窝后无收缩；上颚极小，前侧角秃钝，或有尖刺伸出；触角各节不很延长，上唇极短。
/species/xiaitermes-yinxianensis/.worker: 工蚁亦分大、小两型。大型个体头赤褐色，淡色 T 形缝明显，触角黄褐，前胸背板色泽近似触角，足黄褐，头面毛稀疏。头略作稍宽的圆形，最宽处在触角窝之后，囟圆形而下凹，位于 T 缝交叉点正后方，后唇基隆起；触角十五节，第二节长于第三或第四节；前胸背板马鞍形，前缘凹陷，后缘中凹不显。小型个体头色较大型为浅，毛序与之相同；头作方形而带圆，后唇基隆起，触角十四节，第四节最短；前胸背板马鞍形，前缘中凹明显，后缘中凹不显。
